meaning: adj. 賣弄學問的；拘泥細節的

meaning: adj. 不可調和的；無法和解的

The tempest damaged many houses. (暴風雨破壞了許多房子。)

meaning: adj. 有罪責的；應受譴責的

meaning: adj. 毫無根據的；無理由的

The professor's explication clarified why the two studies reached different conclusions despite using similar data. (教授的詳解說明了為何兩項研究使用相似資料卻得到不同結論。)

meaning: adj. 有勇無謀的；魯莽的

The speech became a diatribe against regulators, offering accusations but little evidence about the policy's actual effects. (演說變成對監管者的長篇抨擊，提出指控卻幾乎沒有政策實際影響的證據。)

meaning: adj. 不間斷的；持續不懈的

The team's inventiveness produced a low cost solution that met safety requirements without delaying the launch. (團隊的創意提出低成本方案，既符合安全要求，又未延誤上市。)

meaning: adj. 名聲不佳的；不光彩的

The novel's amorous subplot distracted from its central argument about class and political power. (小說的戀愛支線分散了讀者對階級與政治權力核心論點的注意。)
The unreality of the forecast became obvious when actual demand exceeded its highest projected estimate. (實際需求超過最高預測值後，預測內容顯得不切實際。)

meaning: adj. 熱情洋溢的；興高采烈的

The court distinguished incitement from harsh criticism, protecting political debate while addressing direct calls for violence. (法院區分煽動暴力與嚴厲批評，在處理直接暴力號召時仍保障政治辯論。)
The inquiry assessed each department's culpability by examining what warnings it received and how it responded. (調查檢視各部門收到哪些警告及如何回應，以判斷其責任。)

meaning: adj. 化身的；具體體現的

meaning: adj. 不善言辭的；難以表達的

meaning: adj. 精闢的；簡潔有力的

Growing disenchantment with city life led them to move to the coast. (對城市生活日益失望，讓他們決定搬到海邊。)
The minister sent a formal missive to regional leaders explaining why the funding schedule had changed. (部長寄出正式函件，向地方領袖說明資金時程變更的原因。)

meaning: n. 反對主流者；逆向投資者
example: The contrarian investor bought shares during the downturn, arguing that market fears had become exaggerated. (這位逆向投資者在市場低迷時買進股票，認為市場恐慌已被誇大。)

meaning: adj. 道德嚴苛的；清教徒式的

Trust formed the substratum of cooperation, allowing researchers to share preliminary results before publication. (信任構成合作的基礎，使研究者能在發表前分享初步成果。)

The supervisor showed forbearance when the new employee made repeated mistakes while learning unfamiliar procedures. (新進員工學習陌生流程時一再犯錯，主管仍展現忍耐。)
The minister fell into disfavor after delaying a promised investigation into contracting practices. (部長延宕調查承包作業的承諾後，逐漸失去支持。)
The indeterminacy of the evidence prevented investigators from identifying a single cause of the accident. (證據的不確定性使調查人員無法認定事故的單一原因。)

meaning: adj. 不合理的；不健全的

Small donations were the lifeblood of the program, covering supplies that larger grants did not fund. (小額捐款是計畫的命脈，支付大型補助未涵蓋的物資費用。)

meaning: adj. 漠不關心的；冷淡的

meaning: n. 可憎之物；令人厭惡的事

meaning: adj. 站不住腳的；不可辯護的

meaning: adj. 無精打采的；遲緩的

Managers were complicit in concealing safety problems because they had received warnings and chose not to act. (經理們收到警告卻選擇不處理，因此共同參與隱瞞安全問題。)

meaning: n. 無所不在；普遍存在

The glaring incongruity between the politician's lavish lifestyle and his public rhetoric alienated working-class voters. (這名政治人物奢侈的生活方式與公開言論明顯不一致，疏遠了勞工階層選民。)
The speaker's sonorous voice held the audience's attention throughout the lengthy public address. (講者洪亮的聲音，在冗長的公開演說中始終吸引聽眾注意。)

meaning: adj. 再度興起的；復甦的

meaning: adj. 受壓迫的；受欺凌的

The report revealed that humdrum administrative tasks consumed time researchers could have spent analyzing results. (報告指出，單調的行政工作耗去研究者原可用於分析結果的時間。)
The witness continued to aver that she had reported the safety hazard before the accident occurred. (證人持續斷言，事故發生前她就已通報安全危害。)
The contrite manager apologized to staff and accepted responsibility for the decisions that caused the layoffs. (懊悔的經理向員工道歉，並為造成裁員的決策承擔責任。)

meaning: n. 重新詮釋；重新解讀

The contractor tried to skulk away from the hearing, but reporters stopped him outside the building. (承包商試圖鬼鬼祟祟離開聽證會，卻在大樓外被記者攔下。)
Pandemonium followed the unexpected announcement as employees rushed to learn whether their positions would be eliminated. (意外公告發布後一片混亂，員工急著打聽自己的職位是否會被裁撤。)

meaning: adj. 有失尊嚴的；不體面的

Residents gathered to remonstrate with officials after the agency approved construction without consulting nearby households. (機關未諮詢附近住戶便批准興建，居民因此集會向官員抗議。)

meaning: adj. 難以言喻的；不可形容的

Her initial naivete about campaign finance disappeared after she reviewed the industry's detailed lobbying records. (她檢視產業詳盡的遊說紀錄後，起初對競選財務的天真看法消失了。)

The city presented a polished visage to visitors, while residents continued to face crumbling infrastructure. (這座城市向訪客展現光鮮外觀，居民卻仍面對破敗的基礎設施。)
The supervisor tended to domineer over junior staff, discouraging them from raising reasonable concerns. (主管常對初階員工專橫，使他們不敢提出合理疑慮。)

meaning: n. 巧妙設計；刻意安排
example: The plot's central contrivance felt forced, weakening an otherwise convincing story about political compromise. (情節的核心安排顯得刻意，削弱了原本頗具說服力的政治妥協故事。)
Several analysts called the plan lunacy because it depended on revenue projections unsupported by any credible evidence. (多名分析師稱這項計畫荒唐，因為它依賴毫無可信證據支持的營收預測。)
She responded with equanimity to harsh criticism, asking reviewers to identify specific flaws in her analysis. (面對嚴厲批評，她仍沉著回應，請審查者指出分析中的具體缺陷。)
The behavioral immobility displayed by the camouflaged predatory beetle ensures it remains completely inconspicuous on tree bark faces. (具有偽裝色的掠食性甲蟲保持不動，確保自己在樹皮上完全不易被發現。)

meaning: n. 歇斯底里者；情緒失控者
example: The reporter rejected the label hysteric and documented political demands stated by demonstrators. (記者拒絕「歇斯底里者」這種標籤，並記錄示威者提出的政治訴求。)

The lobbyist tried to wheedle officials into approving the exemption by promising future investment in their districts. (遊說者承諾未來在官員選區投資，試圖甜言說服他們批准豁免。)
Philosophers often debate the complex relationship between the human mind and its corporeal form. (哲學家經常爭論人類心靈與肉體形態之間的複雜關係。)

meaning: adj. 多變的；反覆無常的

The spokesperson's flippant answer angered residents who had lost homes in the recent storm. (發言人輕率的回答惹怒了最近在風暴中失去家園的居民。)
The nuptial agreement clarified how the couple would divide property if their marriage ended. (婚前協議說明，若婚姻結束，夫妻將如何分配財產。)
The taciturn witness offered little spontaneous detail, so lawyers relied on carefully phrased questions. (這位沉默寡言的證人很少主動提供細節，因此律師依賴仔細措辭的提問。)
The group took a hardline position. (那個團體採取強硬立場。)
The board rejected the revised budget and thereupon suspended all new hiring until the next review. (董事會否決修訂預算，於是立即暫停所有新招聘，直到下次審查。)
The market pullback provided an opportune moment for the firm to buy back its shares. (市場回檔為該公司回購股票提供了良機。)

meaning: v. 輕視；使顯得不重要

The redesign replaced a dowdy waiting room with a brighter space that felt welcoming to patients. (重新設計以明亮空間取代老土的候診室，讓病患感到更受歡迎。)

meaning: adj. 活潑的；精神奕奕的

meaning: adj. 未獲回報的；單戀的

Luxuriant vegetation covers the hillsides after the first heavy rains of summer. (夏季第一場大雨過後，繁茂的植被覆蓋山坡。)

meaning: adj. 別有用心的；隱藏的

meaning: adj. 不可原諒的；無法辯解的

meaning: adj. 蒙恩惠的；受制於人的

meaning: n. 煽動者；挑起事端者

The archive contained a miscellany of letters, receipts, maps, and unfinished drafts from the same historical period. (檔案館收藏同一歷史時期的各種資料，包括信件、收據、地圖與未完成草稿。)
The small research team showed its mettle by completing the study despite equipment failures and severe funding cuts. (儘管設備故障、經費大幅削減，這支小型研究團隊仍展現毅力完成研究。)

meaning: adj. 凌亂的；衣冠不整的
example: The disheveled witness arrived late, explaining that the overnight storm had disrupted every available route. (衣衫凌亂的證人遲到，解釋說夜間風暴阻斷了所有可行路線。)
The gala's finery contrasted sharply with the modest community center where organizers had held earlier meetings. (晚會的華麗服飾與主辦者先前開會的簡樸社區中心形成強烈對比。)
The speaker began to gesticulate when the microphone failed, emphasizing each point with broad movements. (麥克風故障後，講者開始打手勢，用大幅動作強調每個重點。)
The analyst argued that the remaining funds were merely the dreg of a budget already depleted by wasteful contracts. (分析師認為，剩餘資金只是已被浪費性合約耗盡的預算殘渣。)

meaning: adj. 不可知的；無法了解的
example: Some uncertainty is unknowable because future consumer behavior can change in response to events no model anticipates. (有些不確定性無從得知，因為未來消費行為可能因模型無法預料的事件而改變。)

meaning: adj. 隕石的；流星的；疾速的
example: Geologists discovered a crater that preserves evidence of a catastrophic meteoric impact at the Cretaceous boundary. (地質學家發現了一個隕石坑，保存了白堊紀邊界發生毀滅性隕石撞擊的證據。)

meaning: adj. 易受驚的；緊張不安的
example: Investors remained skittish after the unexpected leadership change, avoiding even companies with otherwise strong earnings. (意外的人事變動後，投資人仍然緊張，連獲利強勁的公司也避開。)
An egocentric leader may disregard evidence when it conflicts with personal ambitions or a preferred public image. (自我中心的領導者可能忽視與個人野心或理想公眾形象相牴觸的證據。)
The vastness of the dataset required new methods for checking errors across millions of individual records. (資料集規模龐大，需要新方法檢查數百萬筆個別紀錄中的錯誤。)

meaning: adj. 近視的；目光短淺的
example: The government's short-term focus was criticized as a myopic economic policy. (政府對短期利益的關注被批評為目光短淺的經濟政策。)

meaning: adj. 反傳統的；破除偶像的
example: Her iconoclastic research challenged assumptions that had guided the field for generations. (她反傳統的研究挑戰了長久以來引導該領域的假設。)

meaning: adj. 有感覺能力的；有知覺的
example: Some philosophers argue that all sentient beings deserve a degree of moral consideration. (有些哲學家主張，所有有感覺能力的生物都應受到某種程度的道德考量。)
Implementation required concurrence from local officials, national regulators, and the project's independent oversight board. (計畫執行需要地方官員、國家監管者與獨立監督委員會一致同意。)

meaning: adj. 不屈不撓的；堅毅的
example: The indomitable organizer rebuilt the campaign after setbacks and continued pressing lawmakers for reform. (這位堅毅的組織者在挫折後重整活動，繼續敦促立法者推動改革。)
The revelation could scandalize voters who trusted the candidate to disclose every major financial conflict. (這項揭露可能令選民震驚，他們原本信任候選人會公開所有重大財務利益衝突。)

meaning: adj. 專橫的；不容置疑的
example: The manager issued a peremptory order without consulting staff who understood the operational risks. (經理未諮詢了解營運風險的員工，便下達專橫命令。)
The supervisor showed solicitude for new employees by checking whether they had adequate training and support. (主管關心新進員工，確認他們是否獲得充分訓練與支援。)
The campaign warned that economic anxiety could fuel xenophobia and hostility toward newcomers. (這項活動警告，經濟焦慮可能助長排外心理與對新移民的敵意。)
The regulation falls within the agency's ambit, but officials lack sufficient staff to enforce it consistently. (這項規定屬於該機關的管轄範圍，但官員缺乏足夠人力一致執行。)

meaning: adj. 不合情理的；過分的
example: The court ruled that the contract's unconscionable fees exploited customers who had few alternatives. (法院裁定合約中不合理的費用剝削了選擇有限的顧客。)
The vendor tried to foist an unnecessary service package on customers who had requested only basic repairs. (顧客只要求基本維修，廠商卻試圖把不必要的服務套裝強加給他們。)
The proposal permitted expropriation of land for public works, provided owners received timely and fair compensation. (提案允許為公共工程徵收土地，但須及時且公平補償地主。)
The bribery scandal threatened to sully the reputation the nonprofit had built through decades of service. (賄賂醜聞可能玷污這個非營利組織數十年來建立的聲譽。)

meaning: n. 微薄薪資；少量金額
example: Workers received a pittance for hazardous overtime, prompting the union to demand a new compensation agreement. (工人領到危險加班的微薄薪資，促使工會要求新的補償協議。)

meaning: adj. 值得稱讚的；可嘉的
example: The team's performance throughout the year was highly creditable, especially considering the challenging market conditions. (考量到艱困的市場環境，團隊全年表現尤其值得稱讚。)
The company did defile the protected river by releasing untreated waste into nearby tributaries. (公司確實將未處理廢棄物排入附近支流，玷污了受保護的河川。)

meaning: adj. 說教的；道德主義的
example: The reviewer found the documentary moralistic because it condemned individual choices without examining structural pressures. (評論者認為紀錄片說教味濃厚，因為它譴責個人選擇，卻不檢視結構性壓力。)
A rushed translation could garble the witness's statement and undermine the reliability of the investigation. (倉促翻譯可能扭曲證人的陳述，損害調查的可靠性。)

meaning: v. 排斥；流放；逐出（社群）
example: Egalitarian tribes would collectively ostracize any individual leader who attempted to monopolize foodstuff resources or hoard weapons. (平等主義部落會集體排斥任何企圖壟斷食物資源或囤積武器的領袖。)

meaning: adj. 輕鬆愉快的；無憂無慮的
example: The lighthearted opening relaxed participants before the moderator introduced the session's contentious policy questions. (輕鬆愉快的開場讓與會者放鬆，之後主持人才提出有爭議的政策問題。)
Ruinous borrowing left the municipality unable to maintain essential services after interest rates rose. (借貸過度造成重大損失，利率上升後市府無力維持基本服務。)
The solicitous manager checked on workers after the accident and arranged additional medical evaluations. (事故後，這位關懷員工的經理前往慰問，並安排額外的醫療評估。)
The executive expressed contrition for misleading investors and committed to publishing corrected financial statements. (主管為誤導投資人表示懊悔，並承諾公布更正後的財務報表。)
The review documented misogyny in workplace policies that penalized mothers more heavily than comparable male employees. (評估記錄職場政策中的厭女現象，母親受到的懲罰比條件相當的男性員工更重。)

meaning: adj. 無懈可擊的；不可動搖的
example: Her conclusion rested on unassailable evidence gathered independently by several research teams. (她的結論建立在數個研究團隊獨立蒐集的確鑿證據上。)
The indigenous populations' historical accounts detail their resistance against colonial subjugation. (原住民的歷史記載詳細描述了他們對殖民征服的反抗。)
She handled the hostile interview with aplomb, answering difficult questions without losing her composure. (她沉著應對敵意訪問，回答棘手問題時也沒有失去冷靜。)

meaning: adj. 無辜的；無可指責的
example: The inquiry found the clerk blameless because established procedures had been unclear and inconsistently applied. (調查認定職員無可指責，因為既定程序本就不明確且執行不一。)
The stolid negotiator showed little emotion, even when the opposing side rejected his central proposal. (這位沉著的談判者幾乎不流露情緒，即使對方否決了他的核心提案。)
The chair dismissed the impertinent remark and returned attention to evidence relevant to the hearing. (主席不理會無禮言論，將注意力拉回與聽證會相關的證據。)
The laconic witness answered in brief phrases, forcing attorneys to ask precise follow up questions. (這位寡言的證人只用簡短語句回答，迫使律師提出精確的追問。)
Her erudition impressed the committee, but she explained complex ideas in language accessible to nonexperts. (她的博學令委員會印象深刻，但她仍用非專家能理解的語言解釋複雜觀念。)
The investigation attributed the failed rollout to managerial ineptitude rather than flaws in the underlying technology. (調查將推出失敗歸因於管理無能，而非底層技術缺陷。)
A bevy of new regulations arrived within months, overwhelming small firms that lacked dedicated compliance staff. (數月內一批新規定接連出台，讓缺乏專職合規人員的小公司難以招架。)
The report assessed the crisis with sobriety, acknowledging both the immediate losses and the uncertain long term effects. (報告嚴肅評估危機，承認眼前損失與不確定的長期影響。)
The awkward announcement caused hilarity in the room, though organizers quickly restored order and continued the meeting. (尷尬的宣布引發全場哄笑，不過主辦者很快恢復秩序並繼續會議。)
Under the strict artistic tutelage of the master craftsman, the journeyman perfected the art of vitrifying stoneware glazes. (在工匠大師嚴格指導下，熟練工匠精進了炻器釉料玻璃化的技術。)
Despite the infirmities of old age, she still walks to the market daily. (儘管年老體弱，她仍每天走到市場。)
The plan went askew when the supplier withdrew, forcing the team to redesign its schedule overnight. (供應商退出後，計畫出了差錯，迫使團隊連夜重新安排時程。)

meaning: adj. 無法反駁的；確鑿的
example: The prosecution presented irrefutable records showing that the official had accepted payments from contractors. (檢方提出無法反駁的紀錄，顯示官員曾收受承包商款項。)
Residents' wariness toward the redevelopment plan grew after earlier promises had failed to materialize. (先前承諾未能實現後，居民對重建計畫更加警覺。)
The inquiry found that the protest began without instigation from outside groups, contrary to official claims. (調查發現，抗議並非外部團體煽動，與官方說法相反。)
The melancholic tone of the memoir reflected the author's regret over choices made decades earlier. (回憶錄憂傷的語調，反映作者對數十年前所做選擇的悔意。)
The mayor dismissed the protesters as rabble, a remark that intensified anger across the divided city. (市長將抗議者斥為烏合之眾，這番話加劇了分裂城市中的怒火。)
The essay examines how economic pressures can shape expectations of matrimony across different social groups. (文章探討經濟壓力如何影響不同社會群體對婚姻的期待。)

meaning: adj. 堅不可摧的；牢不可破的
example: The company's market position seemed impregnable until a cheaper competitor introduced a reliable alternative. (這家公司市場地位看似牢不可破，直到較便宜的競爭者推出可靠替代品。)

meaning: adj. 樸素的；未加修飾的
example: The witness offered an unadorned account of events, avoiding the dramatic language used in earlier reports. (證人樸實地陳述事件經過，沒有使用先前報告中的戲劇化措辭。)
The newspaper's salacious coverage distracted readers from the serious allegations raised in the investigation. (報紙淫穢煽情的報導，讓讀者忽略調查提出的嚴重指控。)
The historian rejected the bloodthirsty stereotype, noting that most leaders pursued negotiated settlements when possible. (歷史學家否定嗜血的刻板印象，指出多數領袖只要可能便尋求談判解決。)
He gave a sheepish smile after realizing that he had criticized a report he had not actually read. (他發現自己批評了一份根本沒讀過的報告後，尷尬地笑了。)
A parsimonious explanation accounted for the findings without relying on several unsupported assumptions. (簡約的解釋無須依賴多項缺乏根據的假設，便能說明研究結果。)
The panel appreciated her esprit, especially when she used a concise joke to expose a flaw in the proposal. (小組欣賞她的機智，尤其是她用簡潔笑話指出提案缺陷時。)
Her snobbish attitude towards cheaper brands made her unpopular among many colleagues. (她對較便宜品牌的勢利態度，讓她在同事之間不受歡迎。)
The lawyer tried to impugn the witness's credibility by highlighting contradictions in several earlier statements. (律師試圖指出證人先前多次陳述矛盾，以質疑其可信度。)
Unclear regulations became the bane of small exporters, who struggled to predict compliance costs. (不明確的規定成了小型出口商的禍根，使他們難以預估合規成本。)

meaning: adj. 欣喜的；幸災樂禍的
example: The gleeful announcement surprised workers who had expected layoffs after the company's disappointing quarterly results. (公司季度業績令人失望，員工原以為會裁員，這項欣喜消息令他們意外。)

meaning: adj. 還原論的；過度簡化的
example: The article offered a reductionist account of poverty by attributing complex outcomes to individual choices alone. (文章把複雜結果全歸因於個人選擇，對貧窮提出過度簡化的解釋。)
The chair chose to forbear from criticizing the draft until all members had reviewed its supporting evidence. (主席選擇暫不批評草案，等所有成員都看過支持證據後再說。)
The executive did not deign to answer employees' questions, reinforcing their suspicion that management was hiding information. (主管不屑回答員工問題，讓他們更加懷疑管理層隱瞞資訊。)
The investigator found the contractor's shifting explanations shifty and requested complete records of every transaction. (調查員認為承包商反覆改變說法很可疑，要求提供每筆交易的完整紀錄。)
A minor dispute over water rights escalated into a regional conflagration after leaders exchanged hostile accusations. (領袖互相指控後，一場水權小爭端升級為區域性大衝突。)
The author argued that relentless propaganda can deprave public debate by rewarding outrage instead of careful reasoning. (作者主張，無止盡的宣傳會獎勵憤怒、貶抑審慎推理，從而腐化公共討論。)

meaning: adj. 拘泥法律的；形式化的
example: The agency's legalistic response followed every procedural rule but failed to address residents' practical concerns. (機關的回應拘泥程序規則，卻沒有處理居民的實際顧慮。)
After exchanging a brief pleasantry, negotiators turned to the difficult questions surrounding the proposed merger. (簡短寒暄後，談判者開始處理合併提案相關的棘手問題。)
The manager's disdainful tone discouraged junior staff from sharing information that could have prevented the costly mistake. (經理輕蔑的語氣讓初階員工不敢分享原可避免重大損失的資訊。)
The memoir describes how the movement indoctrinated new members by cutting them off from family and outside news. (這本回憶錄描述該運動如何切斷新成員與家人及外界新聞的聯繫，對他們灌輸思想。)
The editorial dismissed the executive's histrionic warnings as an attempt to distract shareholders from declining profits. (社論將主管戲劇化的警告視為轉移股東對獲利下滑注意力的手段。)
The policy assumed that alternative suppliers were existent, but the audit found no qualified firms nearby. (政策假設替代供應商確實存在，但稽核發現附近沒有合格廠商。)
The reform would expunge outdated records from the database while preserving documents needed for future audits. (改革將從資料庫刪除過時紀錄，同時保留未來稽核所需文件。)
High transportation costs militate against opening a rural clinic, even when local demand is substantial. (運輸成本高不利於在鄉村開設診所，即使當地需求十分可觀。)
The editorial will lambaste the company for raising prices while reducing service quality and closing local offices. (社論將痛批公司提高價格、降低服務品質，還關閉地方辦公室。)
Fatalism discouraged residents from preparing for floods, although earlier warnings had accurately predicted major damage. (宿命論使居民不願為洪水做準備，儘管先前警告已準確預測重大災損。)
The proposed restrictions were inimical to open research because they prevented scholars from sharing essential data. (這項限制不利於開放研究，因為它阻止學者分享必要資料。)

meaning: n. 闖入者；外來干涉者
example: Local leaders viewed the outside investor as an interloper who ignored community priorities and longstanding agreements. (地方領袖將外來投資者視為闖入者，認為他忽視社區優先事項與長期協議。)

meaning: adj. 羞怯的；缺乏自信的
example: The diffident applicant spoke softly, yet her written proposal showed careful thought and strong command of the subject. (這位缺乏自信的申請者說話輕聲，但書面提案展現周詳思考與深厚掌握。)

meaning: vt. 使精神失常；使動搖
example: The unexpected resignation threatened to unhinge the coalition just as lawmakers were preparing a major reform package. (就在立法者準備重大改革方案之際，意外辭職可能動搖整個聯盟。)
The report condemned barbarous treatment of prisoners and called for independent monitoring of detention facilities. (報告譴責了對囚犯的殘暴對待，並要求獨立監督拘留設施。)

meaning: adj. 開玩笑的；不嚴肅的
example: His facetious reply unsettled the audience, who had expected a serious explanation of the safety failure. (聽眾原期待他嚴肅解釋安全失誤，他開玩笑的回答反而讓大家不安。)

meaning: adj. 截然相反的；對立的
example: A policy of secrecy is antithetical to the transparency required for trustworthy public research. (保密政策與可信公共研究所要求的透明度截然相反。)

meaning: adj. 無法估量的；極大的
example: The archive's destruction caused incalculable losses because many documents had no surviving copies. (檔案遭到摧毀造成無法估量的損失，因為許多文件已無其他副本。)
The court considered whether the rule unjustifiably restricted conjugal visits for inmates and their spouses. (法院審理這項規定是否不合理地限制受刑人與配偶的夫妻探視。)

meaning: vt. 阻撓；拒絕提供資訊
example: Officials continued to stonewall investigators, refusing to explain why procurement records had disappeared. (官員持續阻撓調查人員，拒絕說明採購紀錄為何消失。)
Fitful progress on the negotiations reflected disagreements over financing and the timing of implementation. (談判進展斷斷續續，反映雙方對融資及執行時程仍有歧見。)
In pursuance of the agreement, both firms shared records needed to assess their environmental impact. (為履行協議，兩家公司分享了評估環境影響所需的紀錄。)
The promised perfect compromise proved a chimera once negotiators began confronting the interests each side refused to surrender. (談判者開始面對雙方都不肯放棄的利益後，完美折衷的承諾證明只是幻想。)
Her magisterial review synthesized decades of scholarship and reshaped how researchers understood the political movement. (她權威性的評論綜整數十年研究，並改變研究者對該政治運動的理解。)
Many critics regarded the novel as the apotheosis of the author's style, combining wit, precision, and moral insight. (許多評論家視這部小說為作者風格的巔峰，兼具機智、精確與道德洞察。)
The early protests prefigure the broader movement that would later challenge the government's authority. (早期抗議預示了後來挑戰政府權威的更廣泛運動。)

meaning: adj. 令人厭煩的；惱人的
example: The irksome paperwork delayed reimbursement, discouraging volunteers who had already paid expenses themselves. (惱人的文書作業拖延了核銷，讓已自掏腰包的志工感到灰心。)
The brochure presented a bucolic image of the valley, omitting the factories that dominated its eastern edge. (宣傳冊描繪山谷田園般的景象，卻略過了主宰東側地帶的工廠。)

meaning: adj. 歡樂友善的；熱鬧的
example: The convivial reception encouraged informal discussion between researchers who had previously communicated only by email. (歡樂友善的招待會促成研究者非正式交流，他們之前只透過電子郵件聯絡。)
Investors saw the insurer as stodgy until its new pricing model began attracting younger customers. (投資人原本認為這家保險公司古板，直到新的定價模式開始吸引年輕客戶。)
A cataclysmic earthquake changed the course of the river in a single night. (一場災難性的地震在一夜之間改變了河道。)
The report treated expensive office accoutrement as less urgent than replacing the building's failing heating system. (報告認為，更換大樓故障暖氣系統比購置昂貴辦公配備更急迫。)

meaning: n. 虛無主義；否定一切
example: The philosopher distinguished political nihilism from skepticism that questioned institutions while still seeking constructive reform. (哲學家區分政治虛無主義與另一種懷疑論，後者質疑制度但仍尋求建設性改革。)
The negotiator relied on guile to conceal his priorities, but the opposing team quickly recognized the tactic. (談判者靠狡猾手段隱藏優先事項，但對方很快識破了策略。)

meaning: adj. 易彎曲的；柔韌的；順從的
example: Preindustrial ranchers selected pliable rawhide strips to fashion reliable livestock ropes and clothing items. (工業化前的牧場主挑選柔韌的生牛皮條，用來製作可靠的牲畜繩索與衣物。)
The columnist called one official a lout after he mocked residents who had lost homes in the flood. (官員嘲笑在洪水中失去家園的居民後，專欄作家稱他是粗人。)
The constitution was designed to prevent despotism by separating authority among independent branches of government. (憲法透過將權力分散到獨立政府部門，避免專制統治。)
The judge withdrew from the case to avoid any appearance of partiality toward a former business partner. (法官為避免顯得偏袒昔日商業夥伴，主動退出案件審理。)
Critics argued that protecting inefficient firms would coddle them rather than encourage necessary innovation. (批評者認為，保護低效率企業只會溺愛它們，而非促進必要創新。)
Repeated rejection did not deject the researcher, who revised the proposal and submitted it to another foundation. (研究者多次遭拒仍未氣餒，修改提案後又提交給另一個基金會。)
The report traced a sinuous path through several agencies, making responsibility for the delayed permit difficult to identify. (報告描繪了許可案在多個機關間曲折流轉的過程，讓延誤責任難以釐清。)

meaning: adj. 隱密的；偷偷摸摸的
example: The firm adopted a stealthy expansion strategy, entering small markets before established competitors noticed its presence. (這家公司採取隱密的擴張策略，在老牌競爭者察覺前先進入小型市場。)

meaning: n. 盲目崇拜；偶像崇拜
example: The essay warned against the idolatry of economic growth, arguing that prosperity alone cannot guarantee social well being. (文章警告不要盲目崇拜經濟成長，並指出繁榮本身無法保障社會福祉。)
Voters viewed the apology as insincere because the candidate repeated the same misleading claim days later. (候選人幾天後又重複同一項誤導說法，選民因此認為道歉不真誠。)

meaning: adj. 可憎的；令人厭惡的
example: The report described the loathsome conditions in the detention center and urged immediate independent inspection. (報告描述拘留中心令人厭惡的環境，並敦促立即進行獨立檢查。)
Chronic procrastination delayed the project until rising costs made the original plan impossible to complete. (長期拖延使計畫延宕，直到成本上升，原方案已無法完成。)
Her ascension to the board followed years of work leading difficult negotiations and stabilizing the company. (她多年主持艱難談判並穩定公司後，終於升任董事會成員。)
Cutting funding for maintenance could imperil the safety of the railway network. (削減維修經費可能危及鐵路網的安全。)
Modern scientific methodologies are fundamentally built upon the philosophical framework of rigorous empiricism. (現代科學方法論基本上是建立在嚴謹經驗主義的哲學框架之上的。)
The novelist used a familiar endearment to signal affection without making the conversation sound overly sentimental. (小說家用熟悉的親暱稱呼表達愛意，又不讓對話顯得過分煽情。)
The editor removed a tautology from the report because the second phrase added no new meaning. (編輯刪去報告中的同義反覆，因為第二個片語沒有增加新意。)
Investigators must not entrap suspects by pressuring them to commit offenses they had never considered. (調查人員不得施壓誘使嫌犯犯下他們原本從未考慮過的罪行。)
The conference offered a panoply of workshops, from statistical methods to practical strategies for community engagement. (研討會提供豐富多樣的工作坊，內容從統計方法到社區參與策略都有。)

meaning: adj. 察覺不到的；極微小的
example: The imperceptible change in temperature became meaningful only after researchers tracked it across several years. (溫度的微小變化起初難以察覺，研究者追蹤數年後才發現其意義。)
The investigation identified a proximate cause of the outage but could not explain the deeper organizational failures. (調查找出停電的直接原因，卻無法解釋更深層的組織失誤。)
The playwright used humor to satirize officials who announced ambitious reforms but resisted meaningful oversight. (劇作家以幽默諷刺那些宣布雄心改革、卻抗拒實質監督的官員。)

meaning: adj. 會犯錯的；不完美的
example: Because experts are fallible, the review process requires independent replication before major policy decisions rely on their findings. (專家也會犯錯，因此重大政策決策依據其研究前，必須經過獨立重現。)
Smoking is highly injurious to your respiratory system. (吸菸對你的呼吸系統非常有害。)
The perversity of the incentive system rewarded departments for delaying projects that would benefit the entire organization. (獎勵制度的反常之處，在於它讓部門因延遲有利於整個組織的計畫而受益。)

meaning: vt. 公開羞辱；嚴厲批評
example: Commentators began to pillory the agency after it revealed that officials had ignored repeated safety warnings. (機關承認官員忽視多次安全警告後，評論者開始公開嚴厲批評它。)

meaning: adj. 狂喜的；欣喜若狂的
example: The orchestra received rapturous applause after performing a difficult composition with unusual precision. (樂團以罕見的精準演奏高難度樂曲後，獲得熱烈掌聲。)
The fracas at the council meeting overshadowed the detailed discussion of the proposed housing plan. (市議會會議上的喧鬧，掩蓋了對住宅計畫的詳細討論。)
The literati debated whether the new novel challenged social conventions or merely repeated familiar themes. (文人們辯論這部新小說是否挑戰社會慣例，還是只重複熟悉主題。)
Her faultless calculations strengthened the report, although its recommendations still required broader public consultation. (她無瑕疵的計算強化了報告，但建議仍需要更廣泛的公眾諮詢。)
The speaker's affectation of expertise became obvious when he could not answer basic questions about the data. (這位講者無法回答資料的基本問題，讓他的專家派頭顯得做作。)
The auditor maintained an unblinking focus on the figures despite pressure from executives to finish early. (儘管高層施壓要求提早完成，稽核員仍堅定專注於數據。)
Editors sometimes elide essential qualifications, making the original research appear more certain than it actually was. (編輯有時省略必要的限定條件，使原始研究看起來比實際更加確定。)

meaning: adj. 活潑俏皮的；唐突的
example: Her pert response amused some listeners but struck others as disrespectful toward the senior panelists. (她活潑俏皮的回答逗樂了部分聽眾，卻讓其他人覺得不尊重資深評審。)
The documentary film was careful to present raw investigative facts rather than attempt to moralize the audience. (這部紀錄片非常小心地呈現原始的調查事實，而不是企圖向觀眾說教。)
The review criticized profligate spending that favored short term publicity over essential maintenance and staff training. (審查批評了揮霍式支出，因為它偏重短期宣傳而忽視必要維護與員工訓練。)
She had the temerity to question the founder's assumptions during a meeting attended by major investors. (她竟有膽量在主要投資人出席的會議上質疑創辦人的假設。)

meaning: adj. 享樂主義的；縱欲的
example: The memoir portrays a hedonistic circle that pursued immediate pleasure while ignoring the consequences of debt. (回憶錄描寫一群追求即時享樂、忽視債務後果的人。)
The investigation exposed the executive's duplicity, as he publicly denied a plan he had privately approved. (調查揭露主管口是心非，他私下批准計畫，公開時卻予以否認。)
The senator rejected the insinuation that campaign donations had influenced her position on the proposed legislation. (參議員否認有人影射競選捐款影響了她對法案的立場。)
The company built a palatial headquarters even as it reduced research budgets and laid off experienced engineers. (公司一面削減研究預算並裁撤資深工程師，一面興建宮殿般的總部。)
Her incomprehension was evident when the committee introduced a statistical method she had never encountered. (委員會介紹她從未接觸過的統計方法時，她顯然感到困惑。)
She gave the proposal a sidelong glance, uncertain whether its apparent simplicity concealed serious risks. (她斜眼看著提案，不確定看似簡單的方案是否暗藏重大風險。)
Do not procrastinate when it comes to submitting your monthly expense reports. (提交每月費用報告時請不要拖延。)

meaning: adj. 具虹彩光澤的；色彩斑斕的
example: The mineral crystallization formations inside the limestone cavern exhibit a beautifully iridescent glow under localized light. (石灰岩洞穴中的礦物結晶，在局部照明下發出美麗的虹彩光澤。)

meaning: adj. 令人惋惜的；糟糕的
example: The report called the housing conditions lamentable, citing overcrowding, unsafe wiring, and unreliable water access. (報告指出住房條件令人惋惜，列出擁擠、不安全電線與供水不穩等問題。)
The committee treated the budget ceiling as sacrosanct, refusing to consider changes despite new evidence. (委員會把預算上限視為神聖不可侵犯，即使出現新證據也拒絕考慮調整。)
The plucky startup sued the platform giant over fees that smaller rivals had quietly accepted for years. (這家有膽量的新創公司控告平台巨頭，挑戰小型同業多年來默默接受的收費。)
The hotel's opulence contrasts sharply with the poverty of the surrounding neighborhood. (飯店的富麗與周圍社區的貧困形成強烈對比。)

meaning: adj. 無法辯解的；不合理的
example: The agency admitted that the delay was unjustifiable because officials had ignored repeated warnings about the deadline. (機關承認延誤毫無道理，因為官員忽視了多次期限警告。)
The supposed medical expert was exposed as a charlatan after investigators found fabricated credentials and false testimonials. (調查人員發現偽造資格與虛假推薦後，這名自稱醫療專家的騙子遭到揭穿。)
After weeks of illness, the patient's sallow complexion worried doctors more than the mild fever. (病了數週後，病人蠟黃的臉色比輕微發燒更令醫師擔心。)

meaning: n. 最低點；最低谷；最糟時刻
example: The team hit its nadir after five losses. (五連敗後，隊伍跌到最低點。)
After a careful perusal of the contract, counsel identified clauses that could expose the company to unexpected liability. (仔細審閱合約後，法律顧問找出可能使公司承擔意外責任的條款。)
Despite years of rancor, the former rivals agreed to cooperate on reforms benefiting both communities. (儘管多年來彼此怨恨，昔日對手仍同意合作推動惠及兩個社群的改革。)
Her remarks scintillate with insight, yet she supports each memorable observation with careful evidence. (她的發言閃耀洞見，但每個令人印象深刻的觀察都有謹慎證據支持。)
The despot dissolved the assembly and ruled by decree after suppressing opposition throughout the capital. (這位暴君鎮壓首都各地的反對勢力後，解散議會並以命令統治。)

meaning: vi. 慷慨陳詞；激昂演說
example: The activist began to declaim against the proposal, arguing that it ignored the needs of low income families. (這名倡議者開始慷慨陳詞反對提案，認為它忽視了低收入家庭的需求。)
Her obstinacy prolonged the negotiations, although her concerns about the environmental safeguards were eventually addressed. (她的固執延長了談判，但她對環境保障措施的疑慮最終獲得處理。)
The sudden merger pulled the research center asunder, dividing teams that had collaborated for decades. (突然合併使研究中心分崩離析，拆散合作數十年的團隊。)
The novel describes a swarthy sailor whose travels gave him a distinctive appearance and a skeptical outlook. (小說描寫一位膚色黝黑的水手，他的旅程造就了獨特外貌與懷疑態度。)
To the committee's vexation, the supplier missed another deadline without offering a credible explanation. (供應商又一次錯過期限，且無法提出可信解釋，令委員會十分惱火。)
Any analyst advising the board should be conversant with both the regulatory framework and the firm's operating model. (為董事會提供建議的分析師，應熟悉監管架構與公司的營運模式。)
Her trenchant critique identified weaknesses that supporters of the proposal had repeatedly overlooked. (她犀利的批評指出提案支持者一再忽略的弱點。)
The ancient Greek scholars approached scientific observations with a rigorous philosophic framework. (古希臘學者以嚴謹的哲學框架來對待科學觀察。)

meaning: adj. 站得住腳的；可維持的
example: Their business plan is no longer tenable now that online rivals offer exactly the same service far cheaper. (如今線上競爭對手以更便宜的價格提供完全相同的服務，他們的商業計畫已經站不住腳。)

meaning: adj. 有男子氣概的；精力充沛的
example: The critic praised the essay's virile prose, noting its forceful argument and energetic rhythm. (評論者稱讚文章雄健有力的文風，指出其論證強勁、節奏明快。)
The legal clinic provides free representation to indigent clients who cannot afford private attorneys. (法律診所為無力聘請私人律師的貧困當事人提供免費代理。)
The historian traced the economic consequences of enslavement across generations and connected them to present inequalities. (歷史學家追溯奴役跨世代造成的經濟後果，並將其與當今不平等連結。)
It seemed churlish to reject the volunteers' offer without thanking them for their considerable effort. (拒絕志工的提議卻不感謝他們付出的努力，顯得相當無禮。)
Some investors interpreted the sudden executive departures as a portent of deeper problems inside the company. (部分投資人將高層突然離職解讀為公司內部存在更深問題的預兆。)
A respected mediator agreed to intercede after talks between the labor union and management broke down. (工會與管理層談判破裂後，一位受尊敬的調解人同意介入調停。)
Her apropos question shifted attention from personalities to the proposal's likely effects on small businesses. (她切題的提問讓焦點從個人轉向提案對小型企業可能造成的影響。)

meaning: adj. 散漫的；缺乏紀律的
example: An undisciplined research process made it difficult to reproduce results or identify errors in the original analysis. (散漫的研究流程讓人難以重現結果，也難以找出原始分析的錯誤。)

meaning: adj. 古怪逗趣的；滑稽的
example: His droll commentary made the economic briefing entertaining without obscuring the seriousness of its conclusions. (他古怪逗趣的評論讓經濟簡報更有趣，卻沒有掩蓋結論的重要性。)
The editorial dismissed the fatuous claim that cutting every public service would automatically improve economic efficiency. (社論駁斥了削減所有公共服務就能自動提高經濟效率的愚蠢主張。)

meaning: adj. 乏味的；平淡無奇的
example: Reviewers found the report insipid because it repeated familiar slogans without analyzing the evidence behind them. (審查者認為報告乏味，因為它重複熟悉的口號，卻未分析背後的證據。)
Before the vote, the chair asked each member to recapitulate the principal argument supporting the amendment. (表決前，主席請每位成員重述支持修正案的主要論點。)
Neither the hostile questions nor the unexpected delay seemed to faze the witness during the hearing. (無論是敵意提問或意外延誤，似乎都沒有使證人在聽證會上慌亂。)
News of the settlement brought jubilation to residents who had campaigned for safer water for years. (和解消息讓多年來爭取更安全飲水的居民欣喜若狂。)

meaning: adj. 荒唐可笑的；鬧劇般的
example: Observers called the inquiry farcical after officials ignored witnesses and announced conclusions before reviewing evidence. (官員忽視證人、未審閱證據便宣布結論後，觀察者稱調查荒唐可笑。)
The monumental stone architecture of the aristocratic elite council chambers projected a sense of permanent political gravitas. (貴族議會大廳宏偉的石造建築，營造出永恆的政治莊嚴感。)
The panel faced a knotty legal question involving competing rights and conflicting interpretations of the statute. (小組面對一道棘手的法律問題，涉及相互競爭的權利與對法規的不同解讀。)
The negotiator's timidity prevented her from challenging unrealistic demands that threatened the agreement. (談判者的膽怯使她不敢挑戰威脅協議的不切實際要求。)
The treaty prohibited the subjection of minority communities to compulsory relocation without independent judicial review. (條約禁止未經獨立司法審查，便強迫少數社群搬遷並加以支配。)

meaning: vt. 殘酷對待；使變殘暴
example: The report found that prolonged exposure to violence can brutalize both victims and the institutions meant to protect them. (報告指出，長期暴露於暴力可能使受害者與保護他們的制度都變得殘酷。)

meaning: vt. 預先判斷；偏見定論
example: Reviewers should not prejudge the application before examining the evidence and hearing from the affected community. (審查者應先檢視證據並聽取受影響社群意見，不要預先判斷申請案。)

meaning: adj. 不切實際的；理想化的
example: The plan to eliminate poverty within a year seemed quixotic, but it prompted serious debate about public priorities. (一年內消除貧窮的計畫看似不切實際，卻引發對公共優先事項的認真討論。)
Community leaders condemned the desecration of the memorial and called for a transparent investigation. (社區領袖譴責紀念碑遭到褻瀆，並要求進行透明調查。)
Please apprise the committee of any changes that could affect the timeline or the project's total cost. (如有可能影響時程或計畫總成本的變更，請通知委員會。)
Both sides remained intransigent until a mediator proposed a compromise addressing their most urgent concerns. (調解人提出兼顧雙方最迫切顧慮的折衷方案前，兩邊都不肯妥協。)
The company endured a torrid quarter as falling demand and rising costs squeezed its operating margin. (需求下滑與成本上升擠壓營業利潤，公司度過了艱難的一季。)

meaning: adj. 易處理的；易控制的
example: The revised model made a previously intractable forecasting problem tractable for analysts with limited computing resources. (修訂後的模型讓資源有限的分析師也能處理先前棘手的預測問題。)
The essay's incoherence arose because its author shifted between several incompatible explanations without acknowledging the conflict. (文章在幾種互不相容的解釋間轉換又未承認衝突，因此顯得不連貫。)

meaning: adj. 無可爭辯的；確鑿的
example: The audit produced incontrovertible evidence that several managers had approved payments to nonexistent vendors. (稽核提出確鑿證據，顯示數名經理曾批准支付款項給不存在的供應商。)

meaning: n. 專制主義；絕對主義
example: The historian linked political absolutism to institutions that concentrated authority and limited independent criticism. (歷史學家將專制主義與權力集中、限制獨立批評的制度連結起來。)
The critic's acerbic review faulted the film's shallow characters and predictable ending. (評論家的尖刻影評批評電影角色膚淺、結局又可預測。)

meaning: adj. 無情的；毫不留情的
example: The remorseless schedule left employees exhausted, despite management's assurances that workloads would soon decline. (毫不留情的時程讓員工筋疲力盡，儘管管理層保證工作量很快會下降。)
Reducing the conflict to a single cause is an oversimplification that ignores decades of political and economic change. (把衝突歸結為單一原因是一種過度簡化，忽略了數十年的政治與經濟變遷。)

meaning: adj. 名義上的；有名無實的
example: Although she was the titular head of the organization, major decisions remained under the founder's control. (雖然她名義上是組織領導人，重大決策仍由創辦人掌控。)
The spindly saplings bent under strong winds, revealing how exposed the newly planted hillside remained. (細長的樹苗在強風中彎曲，顯示新植樹坡仍暴露於風中。)

meaning: adj. 強行的；有說服力的
example: The report documented a forcible eviction that occurred despite a court order protecting the tenants. (報告記錄了一場強制驅離，儘管法院命令原本保障租戶權益。)
The reform campaign focused on correcting an iniquity that had denied rural residents equal access to public services. (改革運動聚焦於矯正一項不公正現象：鄉村居民無法平等使用公共服務。)
It was ironical that the agency created to simplify permits introduced the most complicated application process. (諷刺的是，這個為簡化許可而成立的機關，反而推出最複雜的申請流程。)
To her mortification, the presentation revealed that she had relied on an outdated dataset throughout the analysis. (令她窘迫的是，簡報揭露她整個分析過程都依賴過時資料集。)

meaning: adj. 可惡的；令人憎惡的
example: Most people find the practice of testing cosmetics on animals completely abhorrent. (大多數人認為在動物身上測試化妝品的做法非常可惡。)
Through assiduous review, the team identified small errors that had distorted its estimate of annual costs. (團隊勤勉地反覆檢視後，找出扭曲年度成本估算的小錯誤。)
The reviewer was not obtuse; she simply demanded clearer evidence before accepting the surprising conclusion. (審查者並非遲鈍，只是在接受令人意外的結論前要求更清楚的證據。)
Low interest rates created propitious conditions for firms seeking to finance long term infrastructure projects. (低利率為尋求長期基礎建設融資的企業創造了有利條件。)
The new director entered a maelstrom of conflicting priorities, staff departures, and urgent budget demands. (新主管陷入優先事項衝突、人員離職與緊急預算需求交織的混亂局勢。)

meaning: vi. 武斷說教；自大發言
example: The columnist continued to pontificate about fiscal responsibility without acknowledging the tradeoffs in his own proposal. (專欄作家不斷自以為是地說教財政責任，卻不承認自己提案中的取捨。)
Her snide remarks about the intern's accent distracted the team from evaluating his strong research proposal. (她對實習生口音的刻薄評論，讓團隊無法專注評估他出色的研究提案。)
The editorial used extensive evidence to excoriate officials for ignoring warnings about the bridge's structural damage. (社論以大量證據痛斥官員忽視橋梁結構受損的警告。)
The team's exultation was brief because officials later revealed that the final score had been entered incorrectly. (團隊的歡欣很快消退，因為官員後來揭露最終比分輸入錯誤。)

meaning: vt. 使困惑；使不知所措
example: The contradictory testimony seemed to nonplus the investigators, who paused before deciding which witness to question next. (互相矛盾的證詞似乎使調查員不知所措，他們停下來思考下一位要詢問的證人。)
The scam depended on public credulity, persuading people to send money before checking the charity's credentials. (這場詐騙利用大眾的輕信，說服人們未查核慈善機構資格便寄錢。)

meaning: adj. 令人反感的；不公平的
example: The invidious distinction between staff and contractors gave equally qualified workers unequal benefits. (正式員工與約聘人員之間令人反感的區別，使同樣合格的工作者享有不同福利。)

meaning: n. 有志者；志在取得者
example: The mayoral aspirant built support by promising transparent contracts and regular public reporting. (這位有志參選市長的人承諾合約透明並定期公開資訊，以爭取支持。)
Bountiful harvests failed to ease food insecurity because storage and transport remained inadequate. (儘管收成豐富，糧食仍不安全，因為倉儲與交通連結依舊不足。)

meaning: adj. 健壯的；身體硬朗的
example: Though hale and active, the retired judge argued public services should not depend on volunteers. (這位退休法官雖然身體硬朗，仍主張公共服務不應仰賴志工勞力。)

meaning: n. 壟斷控制；嚴密掌控
example: Two suppliers maintained a stranglehold on the market, keeping prices high and limiting access. (兩家供應商壟斷市場，維持高價並限制小型企業取得貨源。)
Officials could not dally while floodwaters approached the region's only chemical storage facility. (洪水逼近該區唯一的化學品倉儲設施，官員不能再拖延。)
The committee condemned the contemptible effort to intimidate witnesses before testimony about procurement fraud. (委員會譴責有人在證人就採購詐欺作證前，以卑劣手段恐嚇他們。)
Independent directors leavened board discussions with scrutiny that executives had long avoided publicly. (幾位獨立董事帶來主管長期迴避的審慎檢視，調和了董事會的討論。)
The hearing grew testy when executives refused to explain why internal safety reports were withheld. (主管拒絕說明為何扣下內部安全報告後，聽證會氣氛變得火爆。)
The essay shows how leaders can transmute public grief into support for sweeping security laws. (文章呈現政治領袖如何把公眾悲痛轉化為支持大幅安全法案的力量。)

meaning: adj. 躁動不安的；難以安撫的
example: Restive shareholders demanded answers after leadership postponed the vote for a third time. (領導階層第三度延後表決後，躁動不安的股東要求說明。)

meaning: vt. 使不願意；使缺乏意願
example: Frequent audits did not disincline the firm from pursuing contracts with unusually weak oversight. (頻繁稽核並未使公司打消爭取監督格外薄弱之合約的念頭。)
The court ruled that the minister could not abrogate treaty obligations through an informal directive. (法院裁定部長不能透過非正式指令廢除條約義務。)
A few officials tittered when the mayor misread figures, but the budget error was serious. (市長看錯數字時，幾名官員竊笑，但預算錯誤其實很嚴重。)

meaning: n. 煽動民意的政客；煽動者
example: The historian described the governor as a demagogue who turned economic anxiety into hostility toward minorities. (歷史學家形容州長是煽動者，把經濟焦慮轉化為對少數族群的敵意。)
Predatory loan terms ensnared households that had little access to conventional credit. (掠奪性貸款條件使難以取得傳統信用的家庭陷入圈套。)
Desirous of foreign investment, officials offered tax concessions without requiring clear public benefits. (官員渴望外資，卻未要求明確公共效益便提供租稅優惠。)
The campaign's vacuous slogans offered no credible response to concerns about housing affordability. (競選活動空洞的口號，無法可信地回應住宅負擔能力的疑慮。)

meaning: adj. 尖酸刻薄的；惡毒的
example: Vitriolic exchanges between candidates obscured substantive differences over healthcare and regional investment. (候選人之間尖酸刻薄的交鋒，模糊了他們對醫療與區域投資的實質差異。)
The archive offers a cornucopia of evidence about how migration reshaped the industrial city. (檔案館提供大量證據，呈現移民如何重塑這座工業城市。)
The senator's invective against journalists failed to answer questions about undisclosed campaign spending. (參議員辱罵記者，卻沒有回答政治獻金支出未揭露的問題。)
The negotiator remained unruffled as reporters pressed him about the leaked minutes. (記者追問外洩會議紀錄時，談判代表仍保持鎮定。)
The report blamed policy myopia for neglecting maintenance while funding highly visible construction projects. (報告將忽視維護、偏重醒目工程的做法歸咎於政策短視。)

meaning: adj. 超凡脫俗的；非現實的
example: The company's otherworldly valuation seemed detached from modest revenue and persistent operating losses. (公司的估值高得不切實際，與其有限營收和持續營業虧損脫節。)
The contractor showed no compunction about billing taxpayers for repairs that were never completed. (承包商對未完成的修繕向納稅人請款，絲毫沒有懊悔。)

meaning: vi. 傻笑；裝腔作勢地笑
example: The executive simpered through the interview while refusing to address workers' unpaid overtime claims. (主管接受訪問時裝腔作勢地傻笑，卻拒絕回應員工未付加班費的指控。)
Management treated questions about safety as disloyalty, discouraging staff from reporting hazards. (管理階層把安全疑問視為不忠，讓員工不敢通報危險。)
The cartoonist lampooned the minister's grand promises by depicting potholes swallowing an entire bus. (漫畫家畫出坑洞吞掉整輛公車，諷刺部長誇大的承諾。)
Executives decamped before creditors arrived, leaving staff to explain the company's unpaid invoices. (債權人抵達前，高階主管匆忙離開，留下員工解釋公司的未付款項。)

meaning: adj. 固執的；一意孤行的
example: A headstrong chief executive ignored advisers and pursued risky expansion during the downturn. (這位固執的執行長不理會顧問，在景氣下滑時仍推動高風險擴張。)

meaning: adj. 宣洩情緒的；令人解脫的
example: For many residents, the hearing was cathartic after years of exclusion from planning decisions. (多年被排除在規劃決策之外後，公開聽證會讓許多居民得以宣洩情緒。)

meaning: n. 沙文主義；盲目優越感
example: Economic chauvinism fueled demands to exclude imports even when local producers could not meet demand. (即使本土生產者無法滿足需求，經濟沙文主義仍助長排斥進口商品的聲浪。)
The report celebrated nonconformity among artists who challenged official accounts of labor history. (報告讚揚藝術家不從俗，挑戰官方對勞工運動的說法。)

meaning: n. 動物群；五花八門的一群
example: The coalition was a menagerie of former rivals, neighborhood groups, and business associations. (這個聯盟由昔日對手、社區團體與商業協會組成，成員五花八門。)

meaning: adj. 不祥的；預示重大事件的
example: A portentous silence followed the announcement that the region's largest employer would close its factory. (該區最大雇主宣布關廠後，現場陷入不祥的沉默。)

meaning: adj. 美麗的；端莊好看的
example: The town's comely historic center attracted visitors, while residents struggled with rising rents. (城鎮美麗的歷史街區吸引遊客，但居民苦於租金上漲與交通擁塞。)

meaning: n. 胡言亂語；難懂的話
example: The filing contained gibberish where financial tables should have supported the company's claims. (財務表格原應支持公司的說法，申報文件裡卻是一堆難懂的內容。)

meaning: adj. 迂迴的；拐彎抹角的
example: The agency's circuitous approval process delayed repairs while offices repeatedly transferred the application. (機關核准流程迂迴拖沓，承辦單位一再轉送申請，延誤緊急修繕。)
The manufacturer ran afoul of export controls after shipping restricted components through an intermediary. (製造商透過中間商運送受限零件後，違反了出口管制規定。)
An ashen finance director announced that the company had exhausted its emergency credit line. (臉色灰白的財務主管宣布，公司已用盡緊急信用額度。)

meaning: vi. 勸人改宗；宣揚信仰
example: The organization was criticized for using public aid programs to proselytize among vulnerable families. (該組織被批評利用公共援助計畫向弱勢家庭宣教。)
Analysts should not pigeonhole rural voters as uniformly opposed to renewable energy investment. (分析師不應把鄉村選民一概歸類為反對再生能源投資。)
The proposal's naivety became clear when officials attempted implementation without staff or reliable data. (官員在缺乏人力與可靠資料下試圖執行，提案的天真之處便顯露出來。)

meaning: adj. 不愛國的；被指不忠的
example: Officials branded criticism of the military budget unpatriotic, though auditors documented substantial waste. (稽核人員記錄大量浪費，官員卻把批評軍事預算的人稱為不愛國。)
The inquiry uncovered subterfuge used to disguise campaign donations as ordinary consulting payments. (調查揭露有人以詭計把政治獻金偽裝成一般顧問費。)
The scale of unpaid hospital bills could stupefy investigators expecting only minor accounting errors. (醫院未付款項的規模令調查人員震驚，他們原以為只是小型會計錯誤。)

meaning: adj. 缺乏創意的；乏味的
example: The committee's uninspired recommendations repeated familiar slogans without addressing persistent regional disparities. (委員會缺乏創意的建議只重複老套口號，沒有處理持續存在的區域差距。)

meaning: adj. 笨拙失禮的；不懂社交的
example: His gauche attempt at humor distracted from serious discussion about layoffs and relocation. (他笨拙失禮的玩笑，讓裁員與遷廠的嚴肅討論失焦。)
The factory's closure sounded the knell for a district whose economy depended on manufacturing. (工廠關閉為這個仰賴製造業的行政區敲響喪鐘。)
The report's lugubrious tone reflected service collapse in villages abandoned by regional authorities. (報告陰鬱的語氣，反映地方機關放棄村落後服務崩潰的情況。)

meaning: n. 劫掠；破壞；破壞行為
example: The agricultural region suffered extensive depredation due to a massive swarm of migratory locusts. (由於大批遷徙性蝗蟲的侵襲，該農業區遭受了廣泛的破壞。)
The columnist warned against reifying market rankings as objective measures of social worth. (專欄作家警告，不應把市場排名具體化為衡量社會價值的客觀標準。)
The politician invoked cultural degeneracy to criticize art challenging traditional gender roles. (政治人物援引文化墮落之說，批評挑戰傳統性別角色的藝術。)
The minister called the reporter's question insolence rather than answering evidence about secret payments. (部長不回應秘密付款的證據，反而稱記者的提問傲慢無禮。)

meaning: adj. 無法回答的；無可辯駁的
example: The auditor posed an unanswerable question: where had the missing public funds actually gone? (稽核人員提出一個無法迴避的問題：失蹤的公款究竟流向何處？)
The documentary finds significance in workaday routines that official histories usually overlook. (紀錄片在官方史書通常忽略的平凡日常中，發現了重要意義。)
The aid package focused on immediate alleviation of food shortages while longer-term repairs proceeded. (援助方案先著重緩解糧食短缺，同時繼續進行長期基礎建設修復。)

meaning: adj. 不應得的；不公平的
example: The employee suffered undeserved blame after managers concealed faulty instructions that caused the accident. (主管隱瞞造成事故的錯誤指示後，員工承受了不應得的責難。)

meaning: adj. 無可匹敵的；無人超越的
example: The archive's unsurpassed collection gave researchers access to records unavailable anywhere else. (這座檔案館無可匹敵的典藏，讓研究者取得其他地方都找不到的紀錄。)

meaning: adj. 毫不掩飾的；公開的
example: Her undisguised relief was obvious when the exam results were finally published online that morning. (考試成績終於在那天早上公布上網時，她毫不掩飾地流露出寬慰。)
Further elucidation of contract terms was necessary before the council could approve the partnership. (議會核准公私協力案前，必須進一步闡明合約條款。)
The minister was abashed when reporters produced documents contradicting his account of negotiations. (記者拿出與部長談判說法矛盾的文件時，他顯得窘迫。)
The revised plan offered not one iota of protection for tenants facing sudden displacement. (修訂計畫對面臨突然迫遷的房客，沒有提供絲毫保障。)

meaning: adj. 錯綜複雜的；迷宮般的
example: The labyrinthine approval process discouraged small businesses from applying for reconstruction grants. (錯綜複雜的核准流程，讓小型企業不願申請重建補助。)
The editorial attributed housing shortages to weak planning and restrictive zoning, not avarice alone. (社論指出，住宅短缺不只是貪婪造成，也與規劃薄弱及分區限制有關。)

meaning: n. 功績主義；唯才是用
example: The company invoked meritocracy while promotion data showed advantages for employees from elite networks. (公司高舉功績主義，但升遷資料顯示菁英人脈仍持續佔優勢。)

meaning: adj. 野蠻粗暴的；殘忍的
example: Witnesses described brutish treatment of detainees while legal counsel was unavailable for several hours. (證人描述律師無法提供協助的時段，被拘留者遭到野蠻對待。)

meaning: n. 誇大陳述；言過其實
example: The audit found an overstatement of projected savings that made the project appear financially viable. (稽核發現預估節省金額遭到誇大，才讓計畫看似財務可行。)

meaning: adj. 似是而非的；貌似有理的
example: The minister offered a specious comparison that ignored differences in population and public health needs. (部長提出貌似有理的比較，卻忽略人口與公共衛生需求的差異。)
Greek theatrical tragedies were designed to induce an emotional catharsis within the gathered public audience. (希臘戲劇悲劇旨在聚集的公眾觀眾中，引發一種情感上的宣洩。)
The report paired lamentation over declining rural services with proposals to restore local clinics. (報告哀嘆鄉村服務衰退，同時提出恢復診所的具體方案。)
A surfeit of luxury apartments did little to ease shortages of affordable homes near transit. (豪宅供給過剩，對緩解交通沿線的平價住宅短缺幫助不大。)

meaning: n. 接合；結合；（地質）凝聚物
example: Sandstone bedrock forms through the long-term compaction and coalescence of granular quartz sand. (砂岩基岩是由石英砂粒長期壓實並逐漸接合而成。)

meaning: n. 因循守舊者；隨俗者
example: The novel portrays a conformist official who values consensus above evidence in every major decision. (小說把隨俗者描寫成一位重視共識勝過證據的高階官員。)

meaning: adj. 難以界定的；無法說明的
example: The neighborhood character remained indefinable despite redevelopment replacing many historic storefronts along the avenue. (儘管都市更新取代許多歷史店面，社區難以界定的特色仍然存在。)
The novel explores how migration can turn ordinary differences into a lasting sense of otherness. (小說探討移民如何把一般差異轉化為長久的他者感。)
Colleagues gathered to commiserate with her after her job application was rejected. (她的申請被拒後，同事們聚在一起安慰她。)
The family left the crowded hovel after the city offered safer housing near the children's school. (市府在孩子學校附近提供較安全的住處後，這家人便離開擁擠的破屋。)
The historian's paean to the reformers overlooked the serious costs their policies imposed on rural communities. (歷史學家對改革者的頌揚，忽略了他們的政策加諸鄉村社區的沉重代價。)
The board rejected the proposal's frivolity, demanding evidence that the project addressed a genuine need. (董事會認為提案流於輕浮，要求提供證據證明計畫能回應真正需求。)

meaning: adj. 巡迴的；四處走動的
example: The peripatetic lecturer taught at several universities each year, adapting his course to different audiences. (這位巡迴講師每年在多所大學授課，並依不同聽眾調整課程。)
The committee dismissed the hoary argument that economic growth must always take priority over environmental protection. (委員會駁斥了經濟成長永遠必須優先於環境保護的陳腐論點。)
The novel contrasts the family's outward gentility with the financial desperation hidden behind their formal manners. (小說對比這家人表面上的文雅，以及禮貌舉止背後的財務困境。)
The audit described the accounting failure as an unmitigated disaster for the firm's credibility. (稽核報告稱這次會計失誤是對公司信譽徹底的災難。)
The letter's poignancy came from its restrained language and the knowledge that its author never returned home. (這封信以克制的文字和作者未能返家的事實，令人深感辛酸。)
Protesters were arrested after they attempted to desecrate the monument during a televised demonstration. (示威者試圖在電視轉播的抗議中褻瀆紀念碑，之後遭到逮捕。)

meaning: adj. 始終如一的；可靠的
example: Her unfailing support helped the junior researchers stay focused during a series of demanding experiments. (她始終如一的支持，幫助初階研究員在一連串艱難實驗中保持專注。)
Years of fieldwork can inure biologists to harsh weather and uncomfortable overnight conditions. (多年的野外工作能使生物學家習慣惡劣天氣與不舒服的過夜環境。)
The review panel used clear criteria to winnow dozens of applications down to five finalists. (審查小組依明確標準篩選數十份申請，留下五名決選者。)
The perpetuation of outdated assumptions can distort research, even when later evidence challenges them. (過時假設的延續會扭曲研究，即使後續證據已對其提出質疑。)
Opposition lawmakers tried to waylay the minister after the hearing, demanding answers about the contract. (聽證會後，反對派議員試圖攔住部長，要求他說明合約問題。)

meaning: adj. 失去知覺的；無感覺的
example: After the accident, the driver remained insensible for several minutes while emergency workers assessed his injuries. (事故後，駕駛失去知覺數分鐘，急救人員則評估他的傷勢。)

meaning: adj. 無可置疑的；確實的
example: The study provided unquestionable evidence that the revised treatment reduced symptoms across diverse patient groups. (研究提供無可置疑的證據，顯示修訂療法能減輕不同患者群體的症狀。)
Investigators found that several employees pilfer supplies from the company warehouse and dismissed them. (調查人員發現幾名員工從公司倉庫偷取物資，於是將他們解雇。)

meaning: adj. 殘忍的；幸災樂禍的
example: The columnist condemned the ghoulish coverage that treated the victims' suffering as entertaining spectacle. (專欄作家譴責了殘忍的報導方式，因為它把受害者的痛苦當成娛樂奇觀。)
Strict debt covenants became a manacle on the firm's ability to invest in new technology. (嚴格的債務契約成了公司投資新技術能力的束縛。)
The director chose to reprove the analyst privately rather than undermine his credibility during the public meeting. (主管選擇私下責備分析師，而非在公開會議上損害他的信譽。)

meaning: adj. 無法估量的；極大的
example: The archive's loss in the fire caused immeasurable damage to historians studying the city's early trade. (檔案館在火災中毀損，對研究該市早期貿易的史學家造成無法估量的損失。)
The judge's rectitude was widely respected because she applied the same standards to powerful and ordinary litigants. (法官對權勢與一般訴訟當事人一視同仁，因此她的正直廣受尊敬。)
The manager tried to compartmentalize personal disagreements so the team could continue working toward shared goals. (經理試著把個人歧見分開處理，讓團隊繼續朝共同目標努力。)
The movement reached its apogee after the election, when its leaders briefly controlled the national legislature. (選舉後，該運動短暫掌控國會，聲勢達到頂點。)
Her discernment helped the committee distinguish reliable evidence from confident but unsupported testimony. (她的洞察力幫助委員會區分可靠證據與自信卻缺乏根據的證詞。)

meaning: adj. 令人敬畏的；強大的
example: The redoubtable economist challenged the panel's assumptions with data drawn from three decades of trade records. (這位令人敬畏的經濟學家以三十年的貿易資料，質疑小組的假設。)

meaning: adj. 不受傷害的；無懈可擊的
example: The firm once seemed invulnerable, but a sudden shift in consumer preferences exposed its weak strategy. (這家公司一度看似無懈可擊，但消費者偏好突然改變，暴露了它薄弱的策略。)
The judge found no personal animus between the officials, despite their sharply different positions on the policy. (儘管官員對政策立場截然不同，法官仍認定彼此沒有私人敵意。)
A single inaccurate assumption could vitiate the entire analysis, even if every later calculation was correct. (即使後續計算全都正確，一項錯誤假設仍可能損害整份分析。)

meaning: adj. 未馴服的；未受控制的
example: The documentary portrayed the untamed river as both a vital resource and a persistent danger to nearby villages. (紀錄片將未受控制的河流描繪為重要資源，也是附近村莊持續面臨的危險。)
Visitors stood awestruck before the ancient structure, whose scale exceeded every description they had read. (遊客站在古老建築前驚嘆不已，它的規模遠超他們讀過的任何描述。)
A moment of levity eased the tension, but the chair quickly returned the meeting to its serious agenda. (一時的輕鬆緩和了緊張，但主席很快讓會議回到嚴肅議程。)
After days of rumination, the researcher concluded that the surprising result required a new theoretical explanation. (沉思數日後，研究者認為這項意外結果需要新的理論解釋。)
The early naysayer later acknowledged that the pilot program had delivered measurable benefits to residents. (這位早期反對者後來承認，試辦計畫為居民帶來了可衡量的好處。)
Investors viewed the sudden forecast askance because management had repeatedly missed earlier projections. (管理層先前多次未達預測，因此投資人懷疑地看待這次突然發布的預測。)

meaning: vt. 使失去人性；非人化
example: Officials warned that describing migrants as threats could dehumanize them and weaken public support for fair treatment. (官員警告，將移民描述成威脅可能使他們失去人性，也削弱大眾支持公平對待的意願。)
Falling enrollment may portend deeper problems if schools cannot adapt their programs to changing community needs. (若學校無法依社區需求調整課程，入學人數下降可能預示更深層的問題。)

meaning: adj. 愛開玩笑的；詼諧的
example: The usually jocular chief executive turned grave when analysts asked about the pension shortfall. (平常愛開玩笑的執行長，在分析師問到退休金缺口時變得嚴肅。)

meaning: n. 奇思妙想；異想天開
example: The designer added a touch of whimsy to the exhibit without distracting visitors from its historical message. (設計師為展覽增添一點奇思妙想，卻沒有讓訪客忽略其歷史訊息。)
The survey revealed widespread despondency among workers who saw little chance of advancement or meaningful change. (調查顯示，許多員工看不到升遷或實質改變的機會，普遍感到沮喪。)
The uncomprehending audience stared silently as the lecturer introduced another complex theory without examples. (講者又提出一套複雜理論卻沒有舉例，聽眾茫然地沉默看著他。)
The aristocratic heir led an indolent lifestyle, spending most of his days lounging in luxury resorts. (這位貴族繼承人過著慵懶的生活，大部分時間都在奢華的度假村裡閒晃。)
The small state's primary became a bellwether for national voter sentiment during the presidential campaign. (這個小州的初選成為總統選戰期間全國選民情緒的風向標。)
The scandal brought infamy to an institution that had previously been regarded as a model of public service. (這場醜聞讓一個原先被視為公共服務典範的機構聲名狼藉。)
The amendment would eviscerate the oversight law by removing the agency's authority to investigate complaints. (這項修正案會剝奪監督法的實質效力，因為它移除了機關調查申訴的權限。)

meaning: adj. 熱情洋溢的；過分熱烈的
example: Her effusive praise for the proposal surprised colleagues who expected a more restrained assessment. (她對提案熱情洋溢的稱讚，讓原以為她會更克制評估的同事感到意外。)

meaning: n. 修正主義；重新詮釋
example: The historian accused the new textbook of revisionism because it minimized evidence of government repression. (歷史學家指控新教科書採取修正主義，因為它淡化政府鎮壓的證據。)
Local activists struggled to make their concerns heard within a distant officialdom resistant to public input. (地方倡議者難以讓聲音傳入遙遠且抗拒民意的官僚體系。)
The investigation found the allegation baseless after reviewing the records and interviewing every relevant witness. (調查檢視紀錄並訪問相關證人後，認定這項指控毫無根據。)

meaning: adj. 永不消逝的；不朽的
example: The author's undying influence remained visible in the language and themes of younger writers. (這位作家不朽的影響，仍顯現在年輕作家的語言與主題中。)

meaning: adj. 冷淡的；若無其事的
example: He appeared nonchalant about the delay, although the missed deadline threatened the entire funding agreement. (他對延誤看似若無其事，儘管錯過期限可能危及整份資助協議。)

meaning: adj. 無能的；不負責任的
example: Critics called the response feckless because officials announced goals but offered no plan to achieve them. (批評者稱回應毫無作為，因為官員只宣布目標，卻沒有提出達成計畫。)
The officer considered it dishonorable to accept credit for work completed by the entire research team. (這名官員認為，把整個研究團隊完成的成果算在自己名下是不光彩的。)
The columnist portrayed the executive as a buffoon, but offered little evidence for that personal attack. (專欄作家把主管描寫成小丑，卻沒有為這種人身攻擊提出多少證據。)

meaning: adj. 不可侵犯的；神聖的
example: The constitution declares that personal privacy is an inviolable right for every citizen. (憲法宣告個人隱私是每位公民不可侵犯的權利。)
The report condemned rapacious lending practices that trapped borrowers in debts they could never realistically repay. (報告譴責掠奪性的放貸手法，因為借款人因此陷入根本無力償還的債務。)
The medication can inebriate patients, so doctors advise them not to drive until its effects wear off. (這種藥可能使患者昏醉，因此醫師建議藥效消退前不要開車。)
The latest figures should disabuse investors of the belief that demand will recover without additional policy support. (最新數據應能讓投資人醒悟，需求若沒有額外政策支持並不會自行復甦。)

meaning: adj. 奇異的；不切實際的
example: The proposal sounded fantastical until engineers demonstrated that its central technology already worked in practice. (這項提案聽來異想天開，直到工程師證明其核心技術已能實際運作。)

meaning: adj. 不受阻礙的；順暢的
example: The new route gave emergency vehicles unimpeded access to neighborhoods previously isolated by seasonal flooding. (新路線讓救援車輛能順利進入先前因季節性洪水而隔離的社區。)
The dense instructions befuddle applicants, many of whom abandon the process before submitting required documents. (繁複的指示讓申請者困惑，許多人還沒提交必要文件就放棄申請。)
The manager was overwhelmed by the immensity of the task, but he broke it down into smaller steps. (經理被任務的龐大規模壓得喘不過氣，但他把任務拆解成較小步驟。)
The article's conflation of correlation with causation led readers to accept a conclusion the evidence could not support. (文章把相關性與因果關係混為一談，使讀者接受了證據無法支持的結論。)

meaning: adj. 根深蒂固的；積習難改的
example: An inveterate opponent of regulation, she nevertheless supported rules that protected consumers from deceptive fees. (她一向反對管制，卻仍支持保護消費者免受欺騙性費用侵害的規定。)
The investigation identified the miscreant who had altered the records, but it also exposed weaknesses in oversight. (調查找出竄改紀錄的惡棍，也揭露了監督機制的弱點。)
The leader's despotic rule silenced critics and weakened institutions designed to protect minority rights. (領導人的專制統治壓制批評者，並削弱原為保障少數群體權利而設的制度。)
Many readers believe that shared sacrifice can ennoble a community facing a difficult public crisis. (許多讀者相信，共同犧牲能使面臨公共危機的社群變得更高尚。)

meaning: n. 意外發現；機緣巧合
example: By serendipity, the chemist discovered a useful compound while investigating an unrelated reaction. (化學家研究另一種反應時，意外發現了一種有用化合物。)

meaning: adj. 自我中心的；自負的
example: The egotistical director dismissed advice from experienced colleagues and insisted that only his vision mattered. (這位自負的主管不理會資深同事的建議，堅稱只有自己的構想重要。)
The discovery inspired wonderment among researchers because it challenged assumptions they had accepted for decades. (這項發現令研究者驚嘆，因為它挑戰了他們數十年來接受的假設。)
The memoir will limn a society in transition through ordinary choices made by several working families. (這本回憶錄將透過幾個工薪家庭的日常抉擇，描繪轉型中的社會。)
The board was heedless of neighborhood concerns when it approved the warehouse beside the historic market. (董事會核准在歷史市場旁興建倉庫時，完全不顧附近居民的疑慮。)

meaning: n. 因襲主義；傳統觀念
example: The essay challenges conventionalism in urban planning, arguing that familiar zoning rules reinforce inequality. (文章挑戰都市規劃中的因襲主義，認為熟悉的分區規則加深了不平等。)
The minister dissembled about the missing files until reporters published copies of the original correspondence. (記者公布原始往來文件副本前，部長一直掩飾檔案失蹤一事。)
The irascible editor erupted whenever sources challenged the newspaper's account of the labor dispute. (消息來源只要質疑報紙對勞資爭議的報導，這位暴躁的編輯就會大發雷霆。)
The reform package became a hodgepodge of unrelated measures after ministers negotiated separate political concessions. (各部長分別協商政治讓步後，改革方案變成一堆不相干措施的大雜燴。)

meaning: vi. 猶豫不決；搖擺不定
example: The central bank vacillated between raising rates and supporting growth as inflation and unemployment moved unpredictably. (通膨與失業率變化難料，央行在升息與支撐經濟成長之間搖擺不定。)
The exhibition's transgressive imagery challenged official narratives about migration and national identity. (展覽越界的意象挑戰了官方對移民與國家認同的敘事。)

meaning: adj. 少得可憐的；微不足道的
example: Workers rejected a measly settlement that offered little compensation for years of unpaid overtime. (員工拒絕了少得可憐的和解金，因為多年未付加班費幾乎沒有獲得補償。)
The union stoutly defended the wage agreement, arguing that workers had already accepted significant concessions. (工會堅決捍衛薪資協議，指出勞工已經接受了重大讓步。)

meaning: adj. 不受阻礙的；暢通的
example: The agreement guarantees unhindered access for aid convoys crossing the disputed border region. (協議保障救援車隊能暢通通過有爭議的邊境地區。)
The novelist found quiet significance in the ordinariness of workers commuting before sunrise. (小說家在工人日出前通勤的平凡日常中，發現了靜謐的意義。)
The historian warned that removing minority-language records would amount to erasure of an entire community's history. (歷史學家警告，刪除少數族群語言紀錄，等於抹除整個社群的歷史。)
The museum's reverent treatment of the objects contrasted with the violent history of their removal. (博物館以尊敬的態度展示這些文物，與它們被暴力掠走的歷史形成對比。)
The director treated the department as a personal fiefdom, resisting oversight from the central office. (主管把部門當成自己的勢力範圍，抗拒中央辦公室監督。)
It would behoove the agency to publish its assumptions before asking the public to accept the projections. (機關要求大眾接受預測前，理應先公開所採用的假設。)
Residents remained distrustful of the redevelopment plan after officials repeatedly changed its promised compensation terms. (官員一再更改承諾的補償條件後，居民仍不信任都更計畫。)
The crowd's exaltation faded when organizers announced that the promised relief funds had not arrived. (主辦單位宣布承諾的救助款尚未到位後，人群的欣喜若狂逐漸消退。)
The tribunal documented the inhumanity of forced relocations carried out against civilians during the conflict. (法庭記錄了衝突期間對平民強制遷移的殘暴行徑。)

meaning: adj. 突兀的；過分顯眼的
example: The new sign is obtrusive and spoils the view of the old square. (新招牌過分突出，破壞了老廣場的景觀。)
The profile noted the ambassador's sartorial restraint, contrasting it with his predecessors' elaborate ceremonial dress. (人物報導提到大使衣著克制，並與前任繁複的禮服形成對比。)
The director blamed an underling for the filing error, though internal messages showed senior staff approved it. (主管把申報錯誤怪給下屬，但內部訊息顯示高層員工曾批准內容。)
A freakish heat wave damaged crops across several provinces and overwhelmed the region's aging power grid. (異常熱浪摧毀數個省份的作物，也讓老舊電網不堪負荷。)

meaning: n. 長篇抨擊；激烈評論
example: The legislator's screed against journalists drew attention away from the leaked procurement documents. (這名立委長篇抨擊記者，讓外界注意力從外洩的採購文件上轉移。)
The military historian analyzed the brilliant stratagem employed by the general to outmaneuver the opposing forces. (軍事歷史學家分析了將軍用以勝過敵對部隊的精妙計謀。)
Negotiations ended in acrimony after both sides accused the other of concealing key financial terms. (雙方互控對方隱瞞重要財務條件後，談判在敵意中宣告破局。)
The inquiry praised the auditor's probity after she refused pressure to alter the company's financial statements. (她拒絕承受壓力修改公司財報後，調查稱讚稽核人員正直廉潔。)

meaning: n. 關鍵人物；核心要素
example: The regional rail link became the linchpin of the mayor's plan to revive declining commercial districts. (區域鐵路連線成了市長振興衰退商圈計畫的核心。)
Her unblemished record helped reassure investors after the company's previous chief faced a fraud investigation. (前任主管遭詐欺調查後，她清白無瑕的紀錄讓投資人安心。)
The columnist described the policy reversal as unadulterated opportunism, citing the leader's earlier public promises. (專欄作家引用領袖先前的公開承諾，將政策轉彎形容為純粹的投機行為。)

meaning: adj. 清澈的；清晰易懂的
example: Her limpid explanation clarified the treaty's complicated funding formula for residents and reporters alike. (她清晰易懂的說明，讓居民和記者都了解條約複雜的資金公式。)
Reliable public transit undergirds the city's strategy for reducing congestion and expanding access to jobs. (可靠的大眾運輸支撐著市府減少壅塞、擴大就業機會的策略。)
The mayor received plaudits for publishing the city's procurement data in an accessible public database. (市長因將採購資料放上易於查閱的公開資料庫而獲得讚揚。)
The memoir examines filial obligations in a family divided by migration, inheritance, and political loyalties. (回憶錄探討一個因移民、繼承與政治立場而分裂的家庭所面臨的子女責任。)
The novelist's verisimilitude came from meticulous research into how port workers negotiated daily wages. (小說家仔細研究港口工人如何協商日薪，讓作品更逼真。)

meaning: adj. 謹慎保留的；不願透露的
example: Executives remained cagey about the layoffs, offering no dates despite repeated questions from employees. (員工一再追問裁員時間，主管仍謹慎保留，不願提供日期。)

meaning: adj. 粗俗無禮的；笨拙的
example: The diplomat dismissed the uncouth remark as deliberate provocation rather than an accidental breach of etiquette. (外交官認為那句粗俗無禮的話是蓄意挑釁，而非無心失禮。)

meaning: adj. 慈祥親切的；長者般的
example: The veteran columnist adopted an avuncular tone while criticizing the mayor's inexperienced advisory team. (資深專欄作家以慈祥長者般的口吻，批評市長經驗不足的顧問團隊。)
Reviewers called the agency's response amateurish after conflicting statements undermined its credibility. (相互矛盾的說法損害機關公信力，評論者批評其回應不專業。)

meaning: adj. 假裝虔誠的；假道學的
example: The essay mocks sanctimonious executives who promote ethics publicly while rewarding misconduct inside their firms. (文章嘲諷主管公開提倡倫理，私下卻獎勵不當行為，十分假道學。)

meaning: adj. 令人難以忍受的；討厭的
example: The negotiator's insufferable condescension nearly derailed talks before mediators restored a respectful tone. (談判代表令人難以忍受的傲慢，差點讓協商破局，幸好調解人員恢復了尊重的氣氛。)

meaning: adj. 惡意誹謗的；粗鄙的
example: The court dismissed the scurrilous allegations after investigators found no evidence supporting the anonymous accusations. (調查人員找不到證據支持匿名指控後，法院駁回了惡意誹謗的說法。)

meaning: adj. 不受妨礙的；無負擔的
example: The foundation transferred unencumbered land to the city for a new public health center. (基金會把沒有產權負擔的土地移交市府，興建新的公共衛生中心。)

meaning:
adj. 專制主義的；絕對的
n. 專制主義者；絕對論者
example: The historian contrasts the ruler's absolutist vision with provincial leaders who defended local assemblies. (歷史學家將統治者的專制主義願景，與捍衛地方議會的省級領袖作對比。)

meaning: adv. 意味深長地；顯然地
example: Tellingly, the company's revised forecast omitted the market segment that had generated its fastest growth. (耐人尋味的是，公司修訂預測時，省略了成長最快的市場區塊。)

meaning: adj. 過度感傷的；多愁善感的
example: The film avoids a maudlin ending, allowing the bereaved family to express grief without forced reconciliation. (電影沒有採用過度感傷的結局，讓喪親家屬表達悲痛，而非被迫和解。)
The auditor's measured reproof prompted managers to correct reporting errors before the annual filing. (稽核人員克制的責備，促使主管在年度申報前更正報告錯誤。)
The columnist acidly observed that the promised transparency arrived only after reporters uncovered the payments. (專欄作家尖酸地指出，所謂透明化只在記者揭露付款後才出現。)

meaning: adj. 重複冗長的；反覆的
example: The committee trimmed a repetitious report while retaining the evidence needed to support its policy recommendations. (委員會刪減報告中重複冗長的內容，同時保留支持政策建議所需的證據。)

meaning: adv. 毀滅性地；極具衝擊地
example: The court ruled devastatingly against the company, invalidating its core patents and ordering substantial damages. (法院作出對公司極為不利的裁決，撤銷核心專利並判處鉅額賠償。)

meaning: n. 男子氣概；男性生殖力
example: The historian examined how political advertisements tied virility to military strength and national authority. (歷史學家探討政治廣告如何把男子氣概與軍事力量、國家權威連結。)

meaning: adj. 如夢似幻的；夢境般的
example: The photographer's dreamlike images captured a deserted industrial waterfront at dawn, beneath a pale winter sky. (攝影師如夢似幻的影像，捕捉了冬日淡色天空下、黎明時分荒廢的工業濱水區。)

meaning: n. 聲勢漸長；民意浪潮
example: A groundswell of opposition forced the council to reopen hearings on the proposed highway through wetlands. (反對聲浪逐漸擴大，迫使議會重啟對穿越濕地公路計畫的聽證。)
The report described the wretchedness of families living without heat after the region's power network collapsed. (報告描述區域電網崩潰後，家庭在沒有暖氣下生活的悲慘處境。)
The biography separates the ruler's private debauchery from the economic policies that reshaped the kingdom. (傳記將統治者私生活的放蕩，與重塑王國的經濟政策分開討論。)
The museum designed its exhibit to edify visitors without presenting contested colonial history as settled fact. (博物館設計展覽以啟發訪客，同時不把有爭議的殖民史說成定論。)

meaning: adj. 書卷氣的；好讀書的
example: The bookish historian became a compelling broadcaster by connecting archival discoveries to current debates. (這位書卷氣的歷史學家，透過連結檔案新發現與當前辯論，成了引人入勝的主持人。)

meaning: adj. 仿製的；劣質替代的
example: Critics dismissed the redevelopment's ersatz historic style as a poor substitute for preserving original buildings. (批評者認為，重建案仿製的歷史風格很差，無法取代保存原有建築。)

meaning: adv. 拘謹地；一本正經地
example: The spokesperson primly defended the dress code while ignoring complaints about unequal enforcement. (發言人一本正經地為服裝規定辯護，卻忽略執行不一致的投訴。)

meaning: adj. 宿命論的；聽天由命的
example: The report rejected a fatalistic view of factory closures, documenting policy choices that could preserve local employment. (報告反駁工廠關閉只能聽天由命的看法，並記錄了可保留地方就業的政策選擇。)

meaning:
vi. 舉止；表現
vt. 使一致；使相符
example: The agency's decision did not comport with its published standards for evaluating competing bids. (機關的決定與其公布的競標評估標準不符。)

meaning: n. 尖酸刻薄；惡毒言論
example: Online vitriol intensified after the court's ruling, prompting officials to temporarily close public comment forums. (法院裁決後，網路上的惡毒言論升高，官員因此暫時關閉公開留言區。)

meaning: adj. 吃力不討好的；不被感謝的
example: Auditors performed the thankless task of correcting years of inconsistent records before the merger closed. (合併完成前，稽核人員執行了吃力不討好的工作，修正多年不一致的紀錄。)
The minister's telegraphic statement offered no explanation for the sudden reversal of the funding decision. (部長的簡短聲明，沒有解釋為何突然推翻資金決策。)
The report revealed a dispute that could rend the coalition apart before the crucial budget vote. (報告揭露了一場爭端，可能在關鍵預算表決前撕裂這個聯盟。)
Despite the tense negotiations, the ambassador's bonhomie helped both delegations continue their discussion. (儘管談判氣氛緊張，大使的親切仍讓雙方代表團繼續討論。)

meaning: adj. 活潑的；熱情洋溢的
example: Her effervescent personality energized the research group during a long and difficult project. (她活潑的個性讓研究團隊在漫長艱難的計畫期間充滿幹勁。)
Credulous investors accepted the promoter's extraordinary claims without checking the company's financial records. (輕信的投資人未查核公司的財務紀錄，就接受了推廣者誇大的說法。)
The mayor's homespun advice appealed to residents because it addressed their daily concerns in plain language. (市長樸實的建議以淺白語言回應居民的日常擔憂，因此受到歡迎。)
She showed remarkable stoicism while recovering from the injury, refusing to let frustration disrupt her rehabilitation. (她養傷期間展現驚人的堅忍，不讓挫折影響復健。)
Public trust became the keystone of the reform effort, enabling officials to introduce difficult changes. (公眾信任成為改革工作的基石，使官員得以推動艱難變革。)
His boastful account of the negotiation collapsed when other participants described a very different outcome. (其他參與者描述了截然不同的結果後，他對談判的自誇說法便站不住腳。)

meaning: adj. 歡欣鼓舞的；狂喜的
example: The exultant team celebrated its unexpected victory after months of training and several narrow defeats. (訓練數月又歷經幾次惜敗後，球隊意外獲勝，成員欣喜若狂地慶祝。)
Critics challenged the arbitrariness of a rule that imposed different penalties on otherwise similar cases. (批評者質疑一項規定的武斷性，因為它對相似案件施以不同處罰。)
A surreptitious meeting between the rivals raised suspicion that they were negotiating behind their allies' backs. (敵對雙方偷偷會面，引發外界懷疑他們瞞著盟友進行談判。)
The manager's parsimony saved money initially, but chronic understaffing eventually damaged customer service. (經理起初靠節省開支省下了錢，但長期人手不足最終損害了顧客服務。)
The candidate's bombastic promises impressed some voters but worried analysts who examined their cost. (候選人浮誇的承諾打動部分選民，卻讓仔細估算成本的分析師感到擔憂。)
The magician relied on sleight of hand to make the coin appear inside an empty glass. (魔術師運用巧妙手法，讓硬幣出現在空玻璃杯裡。)
The treaty prohibited the infliction of collective punishment on civilians for actions by armed groups. (條約禁止因武裝團體的行動而對平民施加集體懲罰。)
Taking on more debt during a downturn seemed imprudent, especially when the firm's revenue was already falling. (景氣低迷時再增加債務似乎不明智，尤其公司營收已在下滑。)
He answered questions about the scandal with nonchalance, which made reporters suspect he knew more. (他若無其事地回答醜聞相關問題，讓記者懷疑他知道更多內情。)
The dancer's suppleness allowed her to perform demanding movements without straining her joints. (舞者的柔韌度讓她能完成高難度動作，又不會拉傷關節。)
The costly lease became a millstone around the startup's neck after its sales slowed sharply. (銷售急速下滑後，昂貴租約成了這家新創公司的沉重負擔。)
The report's dissonant conclusions reflected disagreements among researchers about how to interpret the evidence. (報告中互相衝突的結論，反映研究者對證據解讀不一。)
The debate drifted into inane arguments about appearances instead of addressing the proposal's central risks. (辯論轉而討論外表這類空洞話題，沒有處理提案的核心風險。)
The policy's abrupt withdrawal risked exacerbation of tensions that had already strained relations between neighboring states. (突然撤回政策可能加劇緊張，使鄰國間原已吃緊的關係更加惡化。)

meaning: adj. 積習難改的；屢教不改的
example: The incorrigible skeptic questioned every estimate, even after independent auditors confirmed the underlying figures. (這位積習難改的懷疑者質疑每項估算，即使獨立稽核員已確認基礎數據。)
The committee lost valuable time debating each triviality instead of deciding how to address the urgent housing shortage. (委員會耗費寶貴時間爭論每件瑣事，沒有決定如何處理迫切的住房短缺。)
The witness's vividness of detail made the account persuasive, although several points remained unverified. (證人的細節描述十分鮮明，使陳述頗具說服力，雖然仍有幾點尚未證實。)

meaning: adj. 內耗的；互相殘殺的
example: Internecine disputes within the party weakened its campaign and allowed a smaller rival to gain support. (黨內互相消耗的爭端削弱了競選活動，讓規模較小的對手獲得支持。)
The autocrat centralized decision making and punished officials who questioned his authority. (這位獨裁者集中了決策權，並懲罰質疑他權威的官員。)
Rumors of a cabal controlling appointments spread after several qualified candidates were unexpectedly rejected. (幾名合格候選人意外遭拒後，出現一個密謀集團操控任命的傳言。)
The founders had only the rudiments of a business plan when they first approached investors. (創辦人第一次接觸投資人時，手上只有營運計畫的雛形。)
The unexpected question seemed to discomfit the spokesperson, who paused before offering a carefully worded reply. (這個意外問題似乎使發言人窘迫，他停頓後才謹慎作答。)

meaning: adj. 多種多樣的；繁多的
example: The committee faced multifarious challenges, from budget constraints to disagreements over the project's goals. (委員會面臨多種挑戰，從預算限制到對計畫目標的意見分歧都有。)
The court held the case in abeyance until both parties submitted the missing financial documents. (法院暫緩審理此案，直到雙方提交缺漏的財務文件。)
The editorial condemned the craven decision to avoid confronting corruption despite overwhelming evidence. (社論譴責了明明證據確鑿卻怯於面對貪腐的決定。)
The impostor gained access to confidential files by posing as a consultant hired by the agency. (冒名者假扮成該機關聘請的顧問，因而取得機密檔案。)

meaning: adj. 漫不經心的；輕率的
example: The governor offered a blithe assurance that costs would remain low, despite warnings from independent budget analysts. (儘管獨立預算分析師提出警告，州長仍輕率保證成本會維持低檔。)

meaning: adj. 未受理會的；被忽視的
example: Scientists issued unheeded warnings about the reservoir, which later failed during unusually heavy rainfall. (科學家曾提出警告卻未受重視；水庫後來在異常豪雨中潰堤。)
The pugnacious negotiator repeatedly attacked minor proposals, making it difficult to reach agreement on larger issues. (這位好鬥的談判者反覆攻擊小提案，使雙方難以就重大議題達成協議。)
Her apposite example clarified the abstract principle and helped the audience understand its practical implications. (她貼切的例子闡明了抽象原則，幫助聽眾理解其實際影響。)
The company avoided the ignominy of bankruptcy only after lenders agreed to restructure its debt. (貸款人同意重整債務後，公司才免於破產的恥辱。)

meaning: adj. 不感情用事的；理性的
example: An unsentimental assessment of the program's results helped officials decide whether continued funding was justified. (對計畫成果作理性評估後，官員得以判斷是否有理由繼續提供資金。)
His egotism made collaboration difficult because he treated every suggestion as a challenge to his authority. (他的自我中心讓合作變得困難，因為他把每項建議都視為對權威的挑戰。)
The stringency of the new standards surprised manufacturers, who had expected a longer transition period. (新標準的嚴格程度讓製造商驚訝，他們原本預期過渡期會更長。)

meaning: adj. 糟糕的；慘淡的；悲哀的
example: The underperforming startup reported a woeful financial performance for the fiscal quarter. (這家表現不佳的新創公司公布了本季慘淡的財務表現。)
The initiative was praiseworthy, although its organizers had not secured enough funding to sustain it. (這項倡議值得稱讚，但主辦者尚未取得足夠資金以維持下去。)
The candidate spoke disarmingly about her mistakes, which made voters more willing to trust her account. (候選人坦率談論自己的錯誤，讓選民更願意相信她的說法。)

meaning: adj. 未減弱的；未減少的
example: Public interest in the inquiry remained undiminished despite repeated delays and limited updates from officials. (儘管調查一再延誤、官員更新有限，公眾對此事的關注仍未減退。)
The financial cataclysm destroyed household savings and forced the government to redesign its banking system. (金融大災變摧毀家庭儲蓄，也迫使政府重新設計銀行制度。)

meaning: adj. 不置可否的；含糊的
example: The spokesperson remained noncommittal about the merger, refusing to confirm whether negotiations had actually begun. (發言人對合併案不置可否，拒絕證實談判是否已經開始。)

meaning: adj. 不請自來的；自發的
example: An unbidden memory of the failed experiment returned whenever the researcher considered repeating the procedure. (研究者每次考慮重做實驗時，失敗經驗便不請自來地浮現。)

meaning: adj. 垂頭喪氣的；沮喪的
