example: The crestfallen proposal team returned to the office after executives rejected its carefully researched plan. (主管否決了精心研究的計畫後，提案團隊垂頭喪氣地回到辦公室。)

meaning: adj. 冗長晦澀的；腫脹的
example: Reviewers found the proposal turgid, obscuring a modest reform beneath pages of technical language. (審查者認為提案冗長晦澀，以大量技術用語掩蓋了幅度有限的改革。)
The columnist mocked the minister's pomposity, noting that his grand promises lacked practical detail. (專欄作家嘲諷部長自大浮誇，指出那些宏大承諾缺乏實際細節。)

meaning: adj. 不擇手段的；無原則的
example: The inquiry described the broker as unprincipled after he concealed fees and forged client signatures. (調查指出，這名經紀人隱瞞費用並偽造客戶簽名，行事毫無原則。)
The filmmaker's irreverence toward national icons angered officials but attracted younger audiences. (導演對國家象徵毫不敬畏，惹惱官員，卻吸引了年輕觀眾。)
The investigation found falsification of sales records designed to conceal losses before the company sought new financing. (調查發現公司在尋求新融資前，偽造銷售紀錄以掩蓋虧損。)
The union leader gave a doleful account of factory closures that had devastated several rural towns. (工會領袖悲傷地描述工廠關閉如何重創數個鄉村城鎮。)
The chair treated the whistleblower's questions as impertinence instead of addressing the evidence she presented. (主席把吹哨者的提問當成無禮冒犯，沒有回應她提出的證據。)
The report measured gradual amelioration in air quality after factories adopted cleaner production methods. (報告測量工廠採用較潔淨製程後，空氣品質逐步改善的情況。)
Her aloofness during the negotiations led staff to mistake caution for indifference toward their concerns. (她談判時的冷淡，讓員工誤以為她漠不關心他們的憂慮。)
The announcement triggered bedlam in the trading room as investors rushed to revise their positions. (消息公布後，投資人爭相調整部位，交易室頓時一片混亂。)

meaning: n. 煽情主義、譁眾取寵
example: Media critics condemned the news channel for prioritizing tabloid sensationalism over objective investigative reporting. (媒體評論家譴責該新聞頻道將小報的煽情主義置於客觀的調查報導之上。)
Although a neophyte in diplomacy, the envoy quickly built trust with negotiators from neighboring states. (這位外交新手雖經驗不足，仍迅速贏得鄰國談判代表的信任。)

meaning: adj. 不謹慎的；輕率洩密的
example: The diplomat's indiscreet comments about the private meeting complicated relations with the neighboring government. (外交官對閉門會議不謹慎的評論，使與鄰國政府的關係更加複雜。)

meaning: adj. 卑躬屈膝的；奴性的
example: The review condemned the editor's servile praise of officials who had restricted independent reporting. (評論譴責編輯卑躬屈膝地稱讚限制獨立報導的官員。)
Officials could not efface public memories of the accident by removing the warning signs from the road. (官員移除道路警示標誌，也無法抹去民眾對事故的記憶。)
An adroit negotiator secured concessions without publicly embarrassing either delegation at the summit. (這位談判代表手腕靈巧，在不讓任何代表團公開難堪的情況下取得讓步。)

meaning: adj. 寬宏大量的；慷慨大方的
example: The defeated candidate was magnanimous, congratulating her rival and urging supporters to respect the result. (落敗的候選人展現寬宏大量，恭喜對手並呼籲支持者尊重結果。)
The dissident's banishment drew criticism from neighboring governments and human rights organizations. (異議人士遭到放逐，引來鄰國政府與人權組織批評。)
The speaker's vivacity kept the audience engaged through a long discussion of budget priorities. (講者充滿活力，讓聽眾在漫長的預算優先順序討論中仍保持投入。)

meaning: n. 掃興結局；虎頭蛇尾
example: After months of publicity, the inquiry's anticlimax disappointed residents who expected clear findings. (經過數月宣傳，調查結果卻虎頭蛇尾，讓期待明確結論的居民失望。)
The chair's smugness irritated colleagues who had spent weeks resolving the crisis he had dismissed. (主席的自鳴得意惹惱了同僚，因為他們花了數週處理他曾不屑一顧的危機。)
The report's lucidity helped legislators understand complex pension liabilities before voting on the reform. (報告內容清晰，讓立法者在表決改革前理解複雜的退休金負債。)

meaning: adj. 脾氣暴躁的；難相處的
example: The cantankerous negotiator rejected every draft until both sides accepted independent oversight. (這位脾氣暴躁的談判代表拒絕每個草案，直到雙方接受獨立監督為止。)

meaning: adj. 辛辣的；刺激有趣的
example: The columnist added a piquant detail about the lobbyist's former clients, sharpening an otherwise dry policy analysis. (專欄作家補充了遊說者過去客戶的辛辣細節，讓原本枯燥的政策分析更引人注意。)
The documentary avoided a reverential tone, examining the leader's achievements alongside serious policy failures. (紀錄片沒有一味崇敬領袖，而是將其成就與嚴重政策失誤一併檢視。)
Their repartee enlivened the hearing, but neither executive answered the committee's central questions. (兩人的機智應答讓聽證會活絡起來，卻沒有人回答委員會的核心問題。)
The candidate's xenophobic rhetoric alarmed business leaders whose firms relied on international workers. (候選人的仇外言論讓仰賴國際勞工的企業領袖感到不安。)
The minister's ignominious retreat followed the release of records contradicting his account of the negotiations. (與部長說法矛盾的紀錄公開後，他以可恥的方式退讓。)
Because cognitive processes cannot be observed directly, psychologists' research depends heavily on inferential logic. (由於認知過程無法被直接觀察，心理學家的研究高度依賴推論邏輯。)
The union blamed the strike on management's inflexibility during talks over scheduling and overtime pay. (工會將罷工歸咎於管理層在排班與加班費談判上缺乏彈性。)

meaning: vt. 使困惑；使不知所措
example: A sudden change in the rules may flummox new applicants who prepared using the earlier instructions. (規則突然改變，可能讓依照舊指示準備的新申請者不知所措。)
The report's imprecision about costs made it impossible for the council to compare competing infrastructure proposals. (報告對成本描述不精確，使議會無法比較相互競爭的基礎建設提案。)
The leader's fragmented arguments failed to cohere into a logical and persuasive political platform. (這位領導人零碎的論點未能凝聚成一個具邏輯性且有說服力的政治政綱。)
The columnist dismissed the policy as plebeian, revealing more about his class prejudice than its merits. (專欄作家稱這項政策粗俗，暴露的卻是他的階級偏見，而非政策本身的缺點。)
The editor chose to foreshorten the introduction so readers could reach the central argument sooner. (編輯決定縮短導言，讓讀者更快讀到核心論點。)
The inquiry described the cover up as an ignoble attempt to protect senior officials from accountability. (調查將掩蓋真相描述為卑劣行徑，目的在保護高層官員免於問責。)

meaning: adj. 教條的；拘泥理論的
example: The negotiator rejected a doctrinaire approach and adjusted the proposal to address local economic conditions. (談判代表拒絕教條式做法，並依地方經濟情況調整提案。)

meaning: adj. 貪求的；積極收購的（商業策略）
example: The firm adopted an acquisitive strategy to accelerate growth through mergers. (該公司採取積極收購策略，透過合併加速成長。)
Her impish grin suggested she had hidden the presentation notes before the meeting began. (她頑皮的笑容暗示她在會議開始前藏起了簡報筆記。)
Despite his diffidence, Marcus presented the findings clearly and answered every question from the committee. (儘管缺乏自信，馬可斯仍清楚報告研究結果，並回答委員會的每個問題。)
The chair asked everyone to remain decorous during the heated discussion about the budget. (主席請大家在激烈討論預算時保持得體。)
The island's insularity has helped preserve its language but limited economic opportunities. (這座島的與世隔絕保存了語言，卻限制了經濟機會。)
Aristocratic art connoisseurs would often deprecate modernist woodcuts, viewing them as cheap, crude, and non-naturalistic formats. (貴族藝術行家經常輕視現代主義木刻版畫，將其視為廉價、粗糙且非自然主義的形式。)
A stirring violin solo can enrapture an audience, holding listeners' attention until the last note fades. (動人的小提琴獨奏能使觀眾陶醉，讓聽眾專注直到最後一個音符消散。)
For longtime supporters, changing the club's traditional colors felt like sacrilege rather than a harmless design update. (對長期支持者而言，更改球隊傳統色彩像是褻瀆，而非無傷大雅的設計更新。)
Her felicitous choice of words eased tensions and helped both sides return to a practical discussion. (她措辭得體，緩和了緊張氣氛，也幫助雙方回到務實討論。)
Reviewers criticized the argument's circularity because its conclusion simply repeated the assumption stated at the beginning. (審查者批評論證有循環性，因為結論只是重複了開頭提出的假設。)
His boorish interruption offended the guests and ended what had been a friendly conversation. (他粗魯地打斷談話，惹惱了賓客，也讓原本愉快的交談就此結束。)

meaning: n. 業餘愛好者；一知半解者
example: Although the reviewer called her a dilettante, she had studied the subject carefully for several years. (雖然評論者稱她是業餘愛好者，她其實已仔細研究這個主題好幾年。)

meaning: adj. 令人沮喪的；令人洩氣的
example: The dispiriting news arrived early on Monday, when the factory confirmed that two hundred local jobs would go. (令人沮喪的消息在週一清晨傳來，工廠確認將裁掉兩百個當地工作。)
The company offered free training as an enticement for experienced engineers to join its smaller regional office. (公司提供免費培訓，作為吸引資深工程師加入較小區域辦公室的誘因。)

meaning: adj. 喋喋不休的；健談的
example: The usually garrulous witness became quiet when the lawyer asked about the missing financial records. (這位平時喋喋不休的證人，在律師詢問遺失的財務紀錄時安靜了下來。)
At the memorial, colleagues will eulogize the scientist for her integrity and commitment to public health. (在追思會上，同事將稱頌這位科學家的正直，以及她對公共衛生的奉獻。)

meaning: adj. 過分熱心的；過度積極的
example: An overzealous security guard delayed the conference by searching every attendee's bag twice. (一名過度積極的保全人員搜查每位與會者的包兩次，耽誤了會議。)

meaning: adj. 不允許的；不合法的
example: The judge ruled that the agency's search was impermissible because officials lacked a valid warrant. (法官裁定該機關的搜索不被允許，因為官員沒有有效的搜查令。)
The biography describes a dissolute period in the author's youth before he adopted a more disciplined life. (傳記描述作者年輕時放蕩的一段日子，之後他才過上更自律的生活。)

meaning: adj. 災難性的；造成重大損害的
example: The crop failure had calamitous economic consequences for the farming community. (作物歉收給農業社區帶來了災難性的經濟後果。)
Officials cited the imminence of severe flooding when they ordered residents to leave the low lying area. (官員以嚴重洪水即將來襲為由，下令居民撤離低窪地區。)
The finicky editor rejected the draft because several citations lacked page numbers and publication dates. (挑剔的編輯退回草稿，因為幾處引文缺少頁碼和出版日期。)

meaning: adj. 未受宣告的；不受矚目的
example: The unheralded policy change took effect overnight, leaving local officials little time to inform residents. (這項未事先宣布的政策變更一夜間生效，地方官員幾乎沒有時間通知居民。)
The dauntless reporter continued investigating despite threats and pressure from powerful political figures. (這位無畏的記者不顧威脅和權勢人物施壓，仍持續調查。)
Spasmodic funding prevented the research team from maintaining equipment and keeping skilled technicians on staff. (斷斷續續的資金讓研究團隊無法維護設備，也難以留住技術人員。)
The pitiless heat made outdoor work dangerous, forcing crews to shorten their shifts during the afternoon. (酷熱無情，使戶外工作變得危險，迫使工班縮短下午的班次。)

meaning: adj. 直率的；未加修飾的
example: The director gave an unvarnished account of the failed launch, including mistakes made by senior managers. (主管毫不修飾地說明了發行失敗的經過，包括高階經理犯下的錯誤。)
The economist rejected the fallacious claim that lower taxes always increase government revenue in every circumstance. (經濟學家駁斥了「減稅在任何情況下都會增加政府收入」這項謬誤主張。)

meaning: n. 世界主義；國際視野
example: The essay praised cosmopolitanism for encouraging people to value cultures beyond their own national traditions. (這篇文章讚揚世界主義，因為它鼓勵人們重視本國傳統以外的文化。)
Management dismissed the supervisor for insubordination after he repeatedly ignored lawful instructions from the regional director. (主管多次無視區域主任的合法指示後，管理層以抗命為由解雇了他。)
The charity focused on preventing destitution among families whose temporary housing benefits had recently expired. (這個慈善組織致力於避免住房補助最近到期的家庭陷入赤貧。)

meaning: n. 忘恩負義；不知感激
example: She viewed his ingratitude as a betrayal after years of support during his difficult career transition. (多年來在他艱難轉職期間支持他後，她認為他的忘恩負義是一種背叛。)
The court described the executive's seizure of legislative authority as an unconstitutional usurpation of power. (法院將行政首長奪取立法權力描述為違憲的權力篡奪。)

meaning: n. 精湛技藝；出色表現
example: The conductor's bravura performance transformed a cautious orchestra into a bold, unified ensemble. (指揮家的精湛表現，讓原本謹慎的樂團蛻變成大膽而和諧的整體。)

meaning:
adj. 卑鄙的；不光明正大的
adv. 暗中地；偷偷地
example: The inquiry found underhand efforts to steer public contracts toward firms owned by political donors. (調查發現有人暗中操作公共合約，將標案導向政治捐款者持有的公司。)

meaning: adj. 可憎的；令人厭惡的
example: The editorial called the prison abuse detestable and demanded an independent investigation into senior officials. (社論譴責獄中虐待行為可憎，並要求獨立調查高層官員。)
The documentary follows astronomers mapping distant galaxies across the vast firmament above the desert. (紀錄片跟拍天文學家在沙漠上空廣闊的蒼穹中繪製遙遠星系圖。)
After months of quiescence, the labor dispute resurfaced when management proposed cutting pension contributions. (勞資爭議沉寂數月後，管理層提議削減退休金提撥，衝突再度浮現。)

meaning: adj. 可辨認的；可察覺的
example: The survey detected no discernable shift in public confidence after the agency published its revised guidelines. (機關公布修訂指引後，調查未發現公眾信心有可察覺的變化。)

meaning: adj. 厚顏無恥的；無禮的
example: The columnist criticized the impudent executive for dismissing workers' safety concerns as mere inconvenience. (專欄作家批評這名厚顏無恥的主管，把員工的安全疑慮當成小麻煩。)
The biography avoids depicting the dictator as purely villainous, examining the institutions that enabled his rule. (傳記沒有把獨裁者描寫成純粹的邪惡之徒，而是檢視助長其統治的制度。)
The critic faulted the adaptation for slavish imitation of the original, leaving its political tensions unexplored. (評論家批評改編作品盲目模仿原作，沒有深入探索其中的政治張力。)
The playwright composed satiric dramas that utilized sharp wit to critique the corruption of urban mercantile monopolies. (這位劇作家創作了諷刺戲劇，利用尖銳的機智來批判城市商業壟斷的腐敗。)
The director faced a mutinous board after abruptly canceling the cost review promised to investors. (主管突然取消對投資人承諾的成本檢討後，董事會群起反抗。)

meaning: adj. 有益健康的；有利的
example: The report found that cleaner air had a salubrious effect on residents with chronic respiratory illness. (報告發現，空氣品質改善對患有慢性呼吸道疾病的居民有益健康。)
The corporation's legal team tried to overawe small claimants with threats of expensive, prolonged litigation. (企業法務團隊試圖以昂貴又漫長的訴訟威脅，使小額求償者畏懼。)
The economist used reflexivity to explain how investors' expectations could alter the market they were forecasting. (經濟學家以反身性說明，投資人的預期如何改變他們正在預測的市場。)

meaning:
n. 落後者；遲緩者
adj. 落後的；遲緩的
example: Once a laggard in renewable energy, the utility now leads regional investment in offshore wind. (這家公用事業公司過去在再生能源領域落後，如今成為區域離岸風電投資的領導者。)

meaning: adj. 深奧難懂的；晦澀的
example: The report translated abstruse accounting rules into practical guidance for small business owners. (報告把深奧難懂的會計規則，轉成小企業主能實際運用的指引。)
The diplomat's belligerence complicated negotiations that had seemed close to a workable ceasefire agreement. (外交官的好戰態度，使原本接近達成可行停火協議的談判變得複雜。)

meaning: adj. 過分拘謹的；假正經的
example: The critic rejected prudish objections to the exhibition, arguing that its historical context mattered more. (評論家反駁對展覽過分拘謹的批評，認為其歷史脈絡更重要。)
The committee's amendments would emasculate the watchdog's authority to investigate conflicts of interest. (委員會的修正案將削弱監督機關調查利益衝突的權限。)
The essay finds political meaning in quotidian routines such as commuting, shopping, and waiting in line. (這篇文章從通勤、購物、排隊等日常作息中探討政治意涵。)
The court rejected a lascivious stereotype that had been used to discredit the complainant's testimony. (法院駁斥了用來詆毀申訴人證詞的淫蕩刻板印象。)
The editor explained that the new policy label was a portmanteau combining two competing economic ideas. (編輯說明，這個新政策名稱是混成詞，結合了兩種彼此競爭的經濟理念。)

meaning: n. 文化適應；文化涵化
example: The sociologist studied acculturation among migrants while documenting how neighborhood traditions persisted. (社會學家研究移民的文化適應，同時記錄鄰里傳統如何延續。)
The company claimed nonexistence of a formal risk policy, despite archived minutes describing its adoption. (儘管封存的會議紀錄記載政策已通過，公司仍聲稱正式風險政策不存在。)
The regulator was remiss in monitoring the lender, allowing risky practices to spread across its branches. (主管機關疏於監督這家貸款機構，讓高風險做法擴散到各分行。)

meaning: adj. 溫文儒雅的；瀟灑的
example: The debonair host guided diplomats through a tense dinner, steering conversation away from disputed borders. (這位溫文儒雅的主人帶領外交官度過緊張晚宴，巧妙避開爭議邊界話題。)

meaning: adj. 幼稚的；缺乏經驗的
example: The profile portrays a callow junior diplomat learning to navigate rivalries inside the foreign ministry. (人物報導描寫一名缺乏經驗的年輕外交官，學著應對外交部內的派系競爭。)
A misapprehension about the tax deadline prompted thousands of businesses to file their returns late. (對報稅期限的誤解，導致數千家企業逾期申報。)
The scandal brought the research institute into disrepute, despite its earlier contributions to public health. (儘管研究機構過去曾對公共衛生有所貢獻，醜聞仍使它聲名狼藉。)

meaning: adj. 堅定不移的；不可動搖的
example: The auditor maintained unshakable confidence in the figures after reconciling every entry against source documents. (稽核人員逐筆對照原始文件後，對這些數字仍抱持堅定信心。)

meaning: adj. 牽強的；不切實際的
example: At first the theory seemed farfetched, but newly discovered shipping records supported its central claim. (這項理論起初聽來牽強，但新發現的航運紀錄支持了它的核心主張。)

meaning:
adj. 尖刻的；收斂的
n. 收斂劑；止血劑
example: Her astringent column criticized the city's glossy redevelopment campaign for ignoring displaced tenants. (她尖刻的專欄批評市府大力宣傳都更，卻忽略被迫遷離的租戶。)
The foundation assessed each applicant's worthiness using transparent criteria rather than personal connections. (基金會依透明標準評估每位申請者是否值得獲助，而非看私人關係。)
Observers noted the ambassador's measured deportment during negotiations that threatened to collapse repeatedly. (談判一再瀕臨破裂，觀察人士仍注意到大使始終舉止沉著。)
The economist studied the simultaneity of wage growth and rising prices across several regional labor markets. (經濟學家研究數個區域勞動市場中薪資成長與物價上漲的同時性。)
The governor took umbrage at the editorial's accusation that emergency grants favored wealthy districts. (社論指緊急補助偏袒富裕地區，州長對此感到惱怒。)
The coalition's inchoate reform agenda gained definition after labor groups proposed specific protections. (勞工團體提出具體保障後，聯盟尚未成形的改革議程才逐漸明確。)

meaning: adj. 不精確的；不確切的
example: The columnist corrected an inexact claim about unemployment after comparing it with the revised labor figures. (專欄作家比對修訂後的勞動數據，修正了一項不精確的失業說法。)

meaning: adj. 同事間融洽的；合議的
example: Despite sharp disagreements, the review panel maintained a collegial atmosphere throughout its deliberations. (儘管意見分歧激烈，審查小組在整個審議過程中仍維持融洽的同事情誼。)
The biography challenges the ruler's image of omnipotence by documenting repeated failures to control provincial governors. (傳記記錄了統治者屢次無法控制地方總督，挑戰其無所不能的形象。)

meaning: adj. 愛管閒事的；多管閒事的
example: An officious supervisor delayed the safety review by demanding approval of every minor procedural change. (一名愛管閒事的主管要求每項小幅程序變更都先獲批准，拖慢安全審查。)

meaning: n. 正式認可；官方批准
example: The report carried the agency's imprimatur, although independent researchers disputed several assumptions. (這份報告獲得機關正式認可，儘管獨立研究者對其中幾項假設提出質疑。)
The legal team questioned the advisability of releasing customer data before the privacy review was complete. (隱私審查尚未完成，法務團隊質疑是否適合先公開客戶資料。)
The historian found little evidence of personal malevolence, attributing the policy's harm to institutional incentives. (歷史學家找不到多少個人惡意的證據，認為政策造成的傷害源自制度誘因。)
The foundation's beneficence funded clinics, but local groups also demanded accountability for every grant. (基金會的善行資助了診所，但地方團體也要求每筆補助都受到監督。)
The director feared that excessive reporting requirements would stultify experimentation across the research division. (主管擔心過多的報告要求會扼殺研究部門各項實驗。)
The review criticized the tabloid's prurient coverage of the victim's private life after the trial. (審判結束後，評論批評小報以淫猥角度報導受害者的私生活。)

meaning: adj. 健談的；口若懸河的
example: The usually voluble chair fell silent when members questioned the missing funds in the annual report. (平常口若懸河的主席，在成員追問年報中短少的資金時沉默了。)

meaning: adj. 不道歉的；不以為意的
example: The firm remained unapologetic about raising fees, arguing that users had received improved security features. (公司對調漲費用毫不歉疚，辯稱使用者已獲得更完善的安全功能。)
Residents condemned the council's callousness after it closed the shelter during an unusually cold winter. (異常寒冬期間議會關閉收容所，居民譴責其冷酷無情。)
The critic praised the essay's profundity, noting how it connected family memory with national history. (評論家稱讚文章思想深刻，指出它如何連結家庭記憶與國家歷史。)
The chair's reiteration of the deadline ended debate about when departments had to submit revised budgets. (主席再次重申截止期限，終結了各部門何時提交修訂預算的爭論。)
The journalist balanced the bleakness of the job figures with interviews describing unexpected signs of recovery. (記者在訪談中提到意外復甦跡象，平衡了就業數據所呈現的黯淡局勢。)
Her guileless account of the negotiation exposed tensions that polished corporate statements had concealed. (她坦率敘述談判經過，揭露了精心修飾的公司聲明所掩蓋的緊張關係。)
Residents complained about putrid water after the treatment plant discharged waste into the canal. (污水處理廠將廢水排入運河後，居民抱怨河水腐臭。)
A fetid odor drifted from the abandoned warehouse, prompting inspectors to investigate chemical leaks. (惡臭從廢棄倉庫飄出，促使檢查人員調查是否有化學物質外漏。)
The editor expressed abhorrence for the deliberate targeting of civilians in the conflict zone. (編輯表達對衝突地區蓄意攻擊平民的憎惡。)

meaning: adj. 多變的；變化無常的
example: The protean artist moved between documentary film, installation, and investigative journalism without losing her voice. (這位多變的藝術家遊走於紀錄片、裝置藝術與調查報導，仍保有個人風格。)

meaning: adj. 迅速有效的；敏捷的
example: An expeditious review allowed the authority to approve temporary shelters before winter temperatures fell. (審查迅速有效，讓主管機關能在冬季氣溫下降前核准臨時收容所。)
The union's formal remonstrance warned that management's schedule violated the negotiated safety agreement. (工會的正式抗議警告，管理層的排班違反了協商達成的安全協議。)
With shipping routes blocked, the manufacturer perforce delayed deliveries and renegotiated several supply contracts. (航線受阻，製造商不得不延遲交貨，並重新協商數份供應合約。)

meaning: n. 漫不經心；無憂無慮
example: The minister's insouciance about rising displacement angered families waiting months for relocation assistance. (部長對流離失所人數增加漫不經心，激怒了等待安置協助數月的家庭。)
The outdoor event was postponed due to the inclement weather forecast for the weekend. (由於預報週末天氣惡劣，戶外活動已延期。)
Her shrewdness helped the cooperative negotiate better prices without jeopardizing long-term supplier relationships. (她的精明讓合作社談到更好的價格，又沒有損害長期供應關係。)

meaning: adj. 頑固的；執拗不改的
example: The obdurate contractor refused to repair the bridge despite documented defects and repeated safety warnings. (儘管缺陷有文件記錄、安全警告也一再提出，頑固的承包商仍拒絕修橋。)

meaning: adj. 彬彬有禮的；騎士精神的
example: The profile praised the chivalrous response of rival negotiators who protected staff during the evacuation. (人物報導稱讚對手談判代表在疏散期間保護工作人員，展現騎士精神。)
The court's nullification of the tariff order forced the ministry to revise its trade policy. (法院廢止關稅命令後，主管部會被迫修訂貿易政策。)
The official agreed to forswear private consulting after auditors uncovered undisclosed payments from contractors. (稽核人員揭露承包商未公開付款後，這名官員同意發誓不再從事私人顧問工作。)
The candidate's bellicose rhetoric alarmed neighboring governments and unsettled investors in regional infrastructure. (候選人的好戰言論令鄰國政府警戒，也使區域基礎建設投資人不安。)
The diplomat made an effort to conciliate the opposing factions. (外交官努力安撫對立派系。)

meaning: adj. 無可匹敵的；絕倫的
example: The archive's peerless collection of labor newspapers reshaped scholarship on the region's industrial history. (檔案館無可匹敵的工運報紙收藏，改寫了該地區產業史研究。)

meaning: adj. 坦率天真的；不造作的
example: Her ingenuous account of the failed merger contrasted sharply with the polished statements issued by executives. (她坦率不造作地說明併購失敗經過，與主管精心修飾的聲明形成強烈對比。)
The executive offered a shamefaced apology after auditors confirmed that the public figures were misleading. (稽核人員確認公布的數字有誤導性後，主管羞愧地道歉。)
The editor upbraided the correspondent for publishing an allegation without checking the court records. (記者未查核法院紀錄就刊出指控，編輯因此斥責了他。)

meaning: adj. 不明智的；不妥當的
example: Given the unstable exchange rate, executives considered a large overseas acquisition inadvisable this quarter. (考量匯率不穩，主管認為本季進行大型海外併購並不明智。)
The sociologist examined how collectivity emerged among residents coordinating repairs after the flood. (社會學家探討居民如何在洪水後協調修繕，逐漸形成集體行動。)
Analysts accused the company of deliberate obfuscation after it buried crucial fees in lengthy disclosures. (公司把重要費用藏在冗長揭露文件裡，分析師因此指控它刻意混淆資訊。)
The review described the agency's slovenly recordkeeping, noting missing invoices and inconsistent dates. (評論指出該機關的紀錄管理十分馬虎，發票遺漏、日期也前後不一。)

meaning: adj. 無法克服的；難以逾越的
example: For the displaced families, the paperwork seemed insuperable until advocates arranged legal assistance. (對流離失所的家庭而言，文書程序難以克服，直到倡議團體安排法律協助。)
The historian found the merchant's betrothal recorded in a ledger alongside property transfers and debts. (歷史學家在帳冊中找到這名商人的婚約紀錄，旁邊還記載財產移轉與債務。)
Investigators said the broker hoodwinked retirees with misleading claims about guaranteed returns. (調查人員表示，這名經紀人以保證報酬的誤導說法欺騙退休人士。)
The contract's verbiage obscured a simple penalty clause that executives had overlooked during review. (合約的繁瑣措辭掩蓋了一條簡單的違約罰則，主管審閱時沒有注意到。)
The nonprofit refused to scrimp on safety inspections, even when grant revenue fell sharply. (即使補助收入大幅下滑，這個非營利組織仍不願在安全檢查上省錢。)

meaning: vt. 剝奪繼承權；取消繼承
example: The memoir recounts how the industrialist threatened to disinherit relatives who opposed his succession plan. (回憶錄提到，這名實業家威脅要剝奪反對其接班計畫的親屬繼承權。)
Despite the hostile questions, the ambassador maintained a calm mien throughout the televised briefing. (面對尖銳提問，這位大使在電視簡報中始終保持沉著神態。)
The columnist called it impudence for executives to demand public subsidies after reporting record profits. (專欄作家批評主管在創下獲利新高後還要求公帑補助，簡直厚顏無恥。)

meaning: n. 秘密會議；閉門會議
example: A conclave of energy ministers met privately to coordinate their response to the supply disruption. (能源部長們舉行閉門會議，協調因應供應中斷的措施。)
The critic portrays the bureaucracy as a leviathan, absorbing local authority and resisting reform. (評論家將官僚體系描寫成龐然大物，不斷吞噬地方權力並抗拒改革。)

meaning: adj. 返祖的；原始本能的
example: The essay describes an atavistic suspicion of outsiders that resurfaced during the political crisis. (這篇文章描述政治危機期間，再度浮現的原始排外猜疑。)

meaning: n. 唯美主義者；藝術鑑賞家
example: The collector was an aesthete who favored neglected paintings over fashionable works at auction. (這位收藏家是個唯美主義者，比起拍賣場上的熱門作品，更偏愛乏人問津的畫作。)
The designer's flamboyance attracted press attention, though investors questioned the collection's commercial appeal. (設計師華麗張揚的風格吸引媒體目光，但投資人質疑系列商品的市場吸引力。)
Viewed as a gestalt, the murals reveal how migration reshaped the city's public memory. (把壁畫視為一個整體形態來看，就能看出移民如何重塑城市的公共記憶。)

meaning: adv. 令人不安地；令人困惑地
example: The forecast was disconcertingly precise about layoffs, months before management acknowledged any financial strain. (裁員預測準確得令人不安，早在管理層承認財務壓力前數月就已提出。)

meaning: adj. 多產的；肥沃的；豐饒的
example: The post-glacial thaw transformed the frozen steppe plain into a highly fecund, fertile livable agricultural valley. (冰河期後融冰將冰凍的大草原轉變成肥沃且適合農耕的谷地。)
The magazine accused the government of cosseting favored industries with tax breaks unavailable to smaller firms. (雜誌指責政府以小企業無法取得的減稅措施，嬌養受青睞的產業。)

meaning: n. 狹隘本位；地方偏見
example: The report warned that corporate parochialism could prevent leaders from recognizing changes in global demand. (報告警告，企業的狹隘本位可能使主管看不見全球需求變化。)
The memoir portrays a faithless adviser who sold confidential correspondence to political rivals. (回憶錄描寫一名背信的顧問，把機密往來信件賣給政敵。)
The unflappable negotiator continued outlining terms while reporters crowded around the conference room. (記者擠滿會議室外時，這位沉著的談判代表仍繼續說明條件。)
A summer languor settled over the port after shipping delays idled several hundred workers. (航運延誤讓數百名工人閒置，港口因此籠罩著夏日的倦怠氣氛。)

meaning: adj. 不一致的；有出入的
example: Auditors flagged discrepant sales totals after comparing invoices with the company's quarterly filings. (稽核人員比對發票與公司季報後，標記出不一致的銷售總額。)

meaning: v. 過度概括；過度泛化
example: Historical geographers warn scholars not to overgeneralize regional climate models based on a single patchy soil sample archive. (歷史地理學家提醒學者，不要只根據單一且零散的土壤樣本紀錄，就過度概括區域氣候模型。)

meaning: adj. 暴怒的；氣到發狂的
example: The minister grew apoplectic when journalists revealed that emergency funds had gone to political allies. (記者揭露緊急基金流向政治盟友後，部長氣得暴跳如雷。)
Management dismissed the veteran engineer as a malcontent, though his safety concerns proved justified. (管理層把資深工程師當成不滿分子，後來證明他的安全疑慮確有根據。)
The architect’s style is characterized by a unique eclecticism. (這位建築師的風格以獨特的折衷主義為特色。)
The novelist used accusations of apostasy to show how rulers disciplined dissenting religious communities. (小說家以叛教指控，呈現統治者如何懲戒異議宗教社群。)
The repentant executive admitted that cost cutting had weakened inspections at the chemical plant. (這名悔悟的主管承認，削減成本削弱了化工廠的檢查作業。)
The union opposed any derogation from workplace protections during negotiations over the proposed restructuring. (工會反對在協商重整計畫期間減損任何職場保障。)
The press lionized the investor after one successful rescue, overlooking years of risky speculation. (投資人成功挽救一家企業後，媒體便把他捧成英雄，忽略多年來的高風險投機。)

meaning: vt. 公開放棄；誓言戒除
example: The dissident refused to abjure her principles, despite offers of immunity and a senior appointment. (儘管有人開出豁免與高階職位，這名異議人士仍拒絕放棄自己的原則。)

meaning: n. 迂腐之人；賣弄學問者
example: The critic was no pedant; she corrected factual errors without dismissing the novel's emotional force. (這位評論家並非迂腐之人，她指出事實錯誤時也沒有否定小說的情感力量。)

meaning: adj. 愛爭吵的；好口角的
example: The quarrelsome child argued with everyone. (那個愛吵架的孩子和每個人爭辯。)

meaning: adj. 粗暴專橫的；橫行霸道的
example: The consortium rode roughshod over neighborhood objections when it approved the terminal expansion. (財團批准擴建貨運站時，粗暴地無視了附近居民的反對。)

meaning: adj. 尖刻諷刺的；辛辣的
example: Her mordant review exposed the museum's glossy campaign as a substitute for meaningful acquisitions. (她尖刻的評論揭露，博物館光鮮的宣傳只是取代實質典藏的手段。)

meaning:
n. 反面；相反的一面
adj. 正面的；相反的
example: The report presents public trust as the obverse of institutional secrecy, not as its automatic result. (報告將公眾信任視為制度保密的相反面，而非保密自然帶來的結果。)
The president's restrained oration acknowledged the victims without turning the ceremony into a campaign event. (總統以克制的正式講辭悼念受害者，沒有把典禮變成競選活動。)
